chapters.title: Chapter 1597 1 - The Prompt Decision
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

Jiang Chen immediately understood what was going on. An ancient palace that appeared out of thin air would surely attract the attention of people. He was afraid that those who passed by here would probably go in to take a look if there was any treasure inside. These twin brothers happened to pass by and saw the innumerable rays of golden light coming out from the ancient palace. Naturally, they would think that treasures were definitely hidden inside. It was understandable and the truth was just as what they had thought. The Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra was certainly considered one of the greatest treasures in the world.

The Buddha Radiance vanished as soon as the Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra was sent into the wondrous rock. As the twin brothers came in and saw that there was only Jiang Chen in the ancient palace, even an idiot would know that the treasure had been kept by Jiang Chen. Furthermore, Jiang Chen was merely an Immortal King. Given their cultivation base, how could they put a puny Immortal King in their eyes? Since they had found this ancient palace, they must seize the treasure in it.
“So what if I don’t.”

Jiang Chen looked interestedly at the two geniuses. These two dudes were really in bad luck. There were so many other people that they could rob, but they had chosen to rob Jiang Chen. Wasn’t this equivalent to courting death? It had always been Jiang Chen who robbed others, not the other way round.

“Otherwise you will die without a burial. Let me tell you kid, we are the people of Huang Family from the Southern Profound Domain of Ethereal Immortal Domain. You are just a puny little Immortal King. You’d better do as we say. As long as you hand over the treasure you obtained from this ancient palace, we will let you live. Of course, don’t think that we are kind individuals. It’s all because you aren’t even qualified to be our enemy and die in our hands.”
One of the them spoke in an extremely arrogant tone, totally not putting Jiang Chen in his eyes.
“Little Chen, don’t waste nonsense with these two idiots. Master Monkey is going into seclusion to comprehend the ancient sutra. Get rid of them quick.”
Dragon Shisan said, then went straight into seclusion. According to Dragon Shisan’s character, he would instantly kill these two with his iron staff without saying a word.

“You two are right. Indeed, I have acquired a good treasure, but it’s impossible for you two to take it away from me, because you don’t have such a capability. I advise you to leave now since there’s still time. I probably will be merciful enough to spare your lives. If you refuse to realise your mistake, I’m afraid that you both are going to die here.”

Jiang Chen spoke in an exhorted tone. He was giving the twin brothers a final chance. He hoped that the two of them would cherish it as he was currently in a good mood, and probably wouldn’t kill the two of them. Given that he wasn’t a compassionate person, he wouldn’t mind taking the lives of these two people if they were too stubborn to listen to his advice. It was too common to kill two men in Golden Horizon.

Nevertheless, after listening to Jiang Chen’s words, the twin brothers of Huang Family reacted the same way as the others. They burst into laughter immediately, feeling as if they had just heard the funniest joke ever. It was undeniably funny that a puny Immortal King could talk to them in such a way.
“Brat, I think that you have been fed up with your life,” said one of them coldly.
“Big Brother, don’t waste time with him anymore. Attack him straightaway. The treasure will naturally be ours.”

The other one showed a cold smile. He unleashed his killing intent and walked towards Jiang Chen, taking one step after another. To him, this Immortal King brat that came from nowhere was definitely seeking death. There was only death in going against him and his brother.
“Brat, I’ll give you one last chance. Hand over the treasure and perhaps you may have the chance to live.” The man’s expression turned gloomily cold all of a sudden.
“You two have too much nonsense.”

Jiang Chen said, then charged at them leaving his afterimage behind. Suddenly his arm grew incomparably thicker and let out an earth-shattering roar. He had launched the terrifying Qilin Arm in his first strike. He simply didn’t want to give his opponent the slightest chance. Just like what Dragon Shisan had said - get rid of them quickly.
“What?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1597 2 - The Birth of the Monkey King
paragraphs: Another 4 PUBLIC BONUS CHAPTERS!

The twin brothers’ expression changed dramatically. Although they were arrogant, they weren’t fools. They knew that they had made a big mistake as soon as they saw the momentum of Jiang Chen’s attack. They knew that they had completely underestimated this Immortal King. The qi exploding from their opponent’s attack had transcended any one of them.
*Roar...*

The majestic Qilin Arm approached one of the twins in the blink of an eye. In an instant, the man was completely enshrouded by the terrifying qi waves. Under such containment, the man had nowhere to run. The only thing he could do was to fight Jiang Chen head on.

Unfortunately, the man had been underestimating Jiang Chen from the beginning, he didn’t think that Jiang Chen would be this powerful. He was completely caught off guard by Jiang Chen. At this moment, he could only depend on his quick reaction. He lifted his fist and unleashed his combat strength to strike at the Qilin Divine Arm.

Upon seeing this, the corners of Jiang Chen’s mouth revealed a sneering smile, knowing how foolish it was to receive the Qilin Divine Arm head on. As a matter of fact, the opponent also knew that this was an idiotic way of fighting, but he was already left with no option at this point. If he didn’t make this move, he would only be waiting for his death.
In fact, such senseless resistance wouldn’t be able to change his fate.
*Hong Long...*

In the instant that his fist connected with Jiang Chen’s Qilin Divine Arm, a sound of bang was heard, the man’s arm was smashed to pieces, and then half of his body was blown away, leaving the other half of his body flying away and landed beside his brother with a puff. He wriggled a few times before losing his breath entirely. Then, a brocade pouch flew from his corpse and fell automatically into Jiang Chen’s hand.
“Second brother!”

The expression of the remaining one changed drastically. His eyes turned completely blood-red. It was just too quick. Everything happened too quickly. He hadn’t even have the time to react and his brother had already died a tragic death in the hands of their opponent.

As a matter of fact, these twins weren’t as incapable. They came from the same womb. The cooperation between the two of them had already reached perfection. Although they were both early Immortal Emperors, their joint combat strength was enough to fight an intermediate Immortal Emperor.

Unfortunately, they underestimated their opponent too much which led to such an outcome. The man hadn’t even had the chance to display his combat strength before being punched to death by Jiang Chen. It was undeniably a miserable death.
“You-you killed my brother!”
The elder brother stared at Jiang Chen with his big red eyes. Fury was burning inside of him. That was hate. The fact that the opponent killed his brother unsettled him.
“Since you and your brother love each other so much, go down and accompany your brother.”

Jiang Chen said and made another frenzied strike. It was the Qilin Divine Arm once again. It reached the remaining brother with the aura of destruction. He didn’t even know about the family or what domain the opponent was from. Anyone who wanted to seize his treasures was nothing more than an enemy. He didn’t care about the status and identity of the enemy at all. Even if it was an expert from the Immortal Court who offended him would still have to die in the end.

There was a saying that said when the amount of debts grew to a certain point, the person wouldn’t be worried in acquiring more, or when there were too many lice, one wouldn’t feel itchy anymore. This was what’s going on to Jiang Chen right now. He already had too many enemies. He wasn’t concerned about a single Huang Family.
*Hong Long...*
“Argh...”

Not long after, a tragic cry erupted once again in the ancient palace. The raging energy had overturned the ancient palace like a decayed wood. The ancient palace that had existed for countless of years had been fully destroyed. Jiang Chen walked out of it nonchalantly. As for the twins, they could no longer walk out as they had been permanently buried in this place, along with the palace.

To the brothers, this was certainly a tragedy. Given their perfect cooperation, they should’ve been able to survive well in Golden Horizon and would have the chance to obtain a lot of benefits. Unfortunately, they had come to offend the figure which they weren’t supposed to offend, and ended up losing their lives here.

There were thousands of geniuses in Golden Horizon. The death of these two geniuses was very common. Even if one had a great reputation outside, you would only be one of them on the wooden bridge. If you didn’t cross it properly, you would fall into the endless abyss.

In the remaining time, without the help and guidance of Dragon Shisan, Jiang Chen wandered aimlessly in the spatial zone. He didn’t expect to find any treasures as these things depended on luck. Despite that, he still headed towards a certain direction, the centre-most in the spatial zone, because he knew very well that as long as he reached the end of the spatial zone, he would be able to walk out of here, and go to the centre of the immortal vault where the Great Earth Immortal Milk was at.

Several hours later, the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda shuddered suddenly. With his divine sense, he discovered that the non lustrous wondrous rock in the thirty-third level was trembling. After a while, countless rays of golden light rushed out of it.
“Little Chen, quickly let me out. Master Monkey is going to be born soon. Haha!”

Dragon Shisan’s voice came from the inside. He laughed, sounding incomparably excited. He had already comprehended the Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra. Although he had only just started comprehending it, it was already enough for him to leap out of the wondrous rock. After being contained in it for so long, he couldn’t help feeling excited about his birth.
“Alright.”

Jiang Chen, too, was extremely excited. From subduing the wondrous rock to the birth of Dragon Shisan was a kind of accomplishment. Without neglect, Jiang Chen opened the pagoda and summoned the wondrous rock. He could almost imagine that the moment the monkey king was born would create an earth-shaking movement. If he let the rock stay inside, it would surely cause a massive mess in the pagoda.

chapters.title: Chapter 1598 1 - As Predicted
paragraphs: The wondrous rock rushed out of the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda and drifted into the void of the spatial zone. Innumerable golden light shot out from it. Qi waves rolled violently. The movement was too big. No one knew how much bigger the movement would be if the monkey had leaped out of the rock.
“With this movement, it definitely will attract a lot of people.”

Jiang Chen’s expression turned grim. Immediately, he formed seals with his hands to deploy a grand formation that enshrouded ten miles of the surroundings so that the movement and noises created could be contained. As a matter of fact, given Jiang Chen’s current cultivation base, he was powerful enough to guard Dragon Shisan and ensure that no one would approach him, but for the sake of not letting any movement out into the outside world, it was the safest way to cover up this place completely.

After the formation was deployed, he walked out of the formation and kept a tight lookout with his cold eyes. Now was the most critical moment for Dragon Shisan, he would never be the slightest polite and merciful to those who came to interrupt the birth of Dragon Shisan.
*Hong Long...*

The Heavens and Earth trembled. The movement in the wondrous rock was getting bigger and bigger. It was like countless lightning was rolling inside. The degree of its shake could turn people’s soul somewhat gloomy. Streams of silk-like golden light solidified and became heavenly rivers hanging in the sky.

This was a very divine scene. It was the scene of the birth of a creature of the Heavens and Earth. This was fate and the incarnation of luck. The birth of an immemorial battle spirit would surely attract the attention of countless people. It was best that Dragon Shisan had chosen to be born here. After all, there were fewer people here and wouldn’t affect him much.

The initially indestructible wondrous rock began to let out cracking sound. Cracks continued to appear on the rock that soon looked like dense spider webs. Golden light then escaped from the cracks, turning the whole spatial zone into a sea of gold light. That was the qi of an immemorial battle spirit. An unparalleled monstrous being was about to be born. It would surely shock the entire world.
“Monkey, given the intensity of your birth, will it draw the heavenly tribulation?”

Jiang Chen began to worry. He knew about the heavenly tribulation all too well. Back in Saint Origin World, he had been struck by the lighting tribulations many times. Due to the laws in the Immortal World being stronger and higher in grade, he hadn’t experienced any heavenly tribulation since his arrival. The birth of the monkey was however too heaven defying. An immemorial battle spirit that had been developing in the wondrous rock for so long would certainly face the wrath of the Heavens during his birth.

“Relax. I’m the life of the Heavens and Earth, I absorb the essence of the Heavens and Earth, and matches with the law and luck of the Heavens and Earth. I will be recognized and tolerated. No heavenly tribulation will strike on me. Otherwise, this spatial zone won’t be able to take it,” Dragon Shisan’s said.

Jiang Chen felt a relief. One should know that the heavenly tribulation wasn’t limited by spaces. No matter where you are, you wouldn’t be able to escape from the senses of the heavenly tribulation. Try to imagine that if the heavenly tribulation happened in this spatial zone, despite the fact that this spatial zone was left behind by an ancient Buddha, it would surely be destroyed by the heavenly tribulation, including the entire immortal vault. The consequences was already imaginable.

However, Dragon Shisan differed from ordinary heaven defying beings. He was created by the Heavens and Earth and had absorbed its essence. His existence conformed to the heavenly Dao and would be recognized by the law of the Heavens and Earth. Furthermore, he had comprehended the Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra which allowed him to walk out of the shackles with the body of freedom. No heavenly tribulation would befall upon him.

More and more cracks appeared on the wondrous rock, giving the possibility that it would crack at any moment. However Jiang Chen knew that it would still need a certain time for the rock to truly explode. The birth of an immemorial battle spirit wouldn’t be that simple.
*Swoosh...* *Swoosh...*

Several silhouettes came one after another. Despite the fact that Jiang Chen had already covered up the qi of Dragon Shisan, the movement was just too big. It was impossible to cover it completely. Any cultivators who were near would naturally be drawn by such an enormous movement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1598 2 - Killing whoever that comes!
paragraphs: “What’s that thing? What a powerful qi! Is that the ancient light of the God of War? That rock must be some rare treasure.”
“That’s truly divine! I can sense the qi of antiquity of a battle spirit. There’s a very powerful creature living inside it. It seems like it’s about to be born soon.”

“Good. This is going to be an unparalleled treasure. Never thought that such mystical rock exist in this immortal vault. I wonder how long has it existed. If I can obtain that rock and make the living creature inside listen to my command, or even refine it, I will be able to obtain boundless benefits.”

There were six or seven people that appeared on the scene. All standing at different positions, watching with blazing eyes glinted with greed. They didn’t know that it was Jiang Chen who had unleashed the wondrous rock. They thought that the rock had been here the whole time and was a treasure left by the ancient Buddha. Also, they were smart enough to know the terror of this type of immemorial battle spirit. This was the spirit of the Heavens and Earth. If they could possess it and obtain its recognition, they would be the master of the creature. Even if they couldn’t, they could refine the creature before it was fully born. The benefits of absorbing its essence was unimaginable. There would surely be a great enhancement in their cultivation base if that were to happen.

Therefore, everyone had developed an incomparable interest in the rock. Some could wait no longer and wanted to lunge at the rock now. Regarding the presence of Jiang Chen, no one seemed to care about it. In their point of view, this white-robed youth was just like them. It was just that he had come slightly earlier than them. The spirit of Heavens and Earth could only be owned by the person who deserved it. In the face of such a situation, they would naturally have to compete for it. Jiang Chen was merely an Immortal King in their eyes. Certainly, no one would give a damn about him. Such level of cultivation didn’t even have the right to fight them. If he really wanted to compete for the treasure with them, it would only bring shame, suffering and even death upon himself.
*Keng!*

Jiang Chen’s eyes turned cold. He drew out the Heavenly Saint Sword with a sharp noise. The dragon sword then let out a deafening sword cry and trembled continuously like a divine dragon that had been revived.
“If you don’t want to die, get lost now!”

Jiang Chen’s cold eyes scanned the surroundings. His tone was also icy cold. The light of the sword had almost shone out his solidified killing intent. This group of people had placed all their thoughts on the wondrous rock, which was an act of courting death. Now that it was Dragon Shisan’s most critical moment, anyone who dared to cross the boundary of the formation would certainly die without burial in his hands.

He would, however, give them a single chance to live, but this would be their last chance. He hoped that they would cherish it, but it seemed impossible as the allure of the rock was just too great. It had already aroused the greed and desire inside of them. Under such a situation, there could only be massacre.
“Humph! A puny little Immortal King wants to own the whole treasure?”
“That’s right. You think that this treasure belongs to you because you have discovered it first? How ridiculous! It seems like you don’t know about the rules in the Golden Horizon at all.”
“Don’t waste time on conversing nonsense with him. Get rid of him first. I’m going to possess that rock today. Whoever stops me will die.”
All of them had been blinded by greed, totally ignoring the warning of Jiang Chen. Almost simultaneously, they lunged towards Jiang Chen’s direction.
“I know the rules of the Golden Horizon a whole lot better than you all.”

Jiang Chen’s dark hair fluttered in the air. His killing intent shot outwards. With a shake of his body, he turned into his dragon-form. He didn’t want to waste too much time with these bastards. In order to ensure the smooth birth of Dragon Shisan, he would have to kill with one strike. He wouldn’t give these people any chance to resist.

He moved like a ferocious tiger. The Heavenly Saint Sword turned into a dazzling light and zipped past the neck of the person who was at the front most. With a wail, the person died on the spot. An early Immortal Emperor genius had just died even before he had the chance to react.
“What?”

Seeing what had happened, the others exclaimed. Their eyes widened. They couldn’t believe what they had just seen. An Immortal King’s combat strength had grown to such extent after just casting out a transformation technique. He could even kill an early Immortal Emperor genius with only one strike. They surely wouldn’t believe it if this didn’t happen before their very eyes.
*Swoosh!* *Swoosh!*

Jiang Chen ignored the shocked look of these people. He made two slashes, right and left, killing two geniuses instantly. The whole process was as easy as cutting and chopping vegetables and melons. Forget about resisting because they didn’t even have the chance to respond. They couldn’t even withstand a blow in front of Jiang Chen.
“Not good, we have underestimated our enemy. He’s too strong. Run quickly!”

The remaining geniuses hastily stopped themselves from moving forward. Although the treasure was incredible, it was nothing compared to their lives. They knew that they had underestimated this Immortal King who turned out to be an extremely abnormal being that could kill so many people in a matter of just a few blinks. What they needed to do now was to run so that they could stay alive.
“None of you will leave. I have already given you the chance. It was you who didn’t cherish it.”

Jiang Chen’s dragon eyes were rippling with flames. His murderous intent soared up to the sky. He raised the sword and thrust it at the remaining geniuses. This was, after all, a cruel world and death was always a normal thing in a place where laws didn’t exist, just like here, in Golden Horizon.
“Argh...” “Argh...” “Argh...”

Along with a few wails, each genius died tragically under the sword of Jiang Chen. Their brocade pouches automatically landed in his palm. After killing these people, Jiang Chen’s expression didn’t change in the slightest. He stood in the void, holding the Heavenly Saint Sword, and still in his dragon form. He would kill whoever that came.

A dozen minutes had passed very quickly. No one had appeared. After all, not everyone that came in this path could sense the movement, and Jiang Chen’s formation was pretty effective. Furthermore, there weren’t plenty of geniuses that came into this immortal vault. There were only a few dozen of people who had picked this path. Adding the twin brothers of Huang Family, there were more than ten people who had died in his hands. To put it bluntly, Jiang Chen was probably the person who had the most brocade pouches. Ever since he arrived in Golden Horizon, almost everyone that met him had died unsurprisingly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1599 1 - Brother Shisan
paragraphs: *Bang!*

Suddenly an explosion was heard from the wondrous rock. Jiang Chen saw something broke apart at the top of the rock, and then an incredibly powerful energy surged out, and the top shell of the wondrous rock crumbled with a sound of Ka Cha.
*Roar...*

A primeval roar came from the wondrous rock. Dragon Shisan stuck out his head, scanning the surroundings with his Fiery Golden Eyes. The golden hair on his head was as sharp as a sword, as though any one of them could pierce through space.
*Roar...*

Dragon Shisan let out an earth-shaking roar. His physique began to expand. Countless golden light flickered like glittering swords and rushed out madly from the rock. Cracking sounds were heard continuously. The lines of cracks on the rock continued to spread. It seemed like the rock was going to burst and collapse at any time.
“Good, he’s going to come out now.”
Jiang Chen’s eyes sparkled. Knowing that nothing else could stop the birth of Dragon Shisan, he immediately heaved a sigh of relief then reverted back to his usual appearance.
*Roar...*
*Hong Long...*

Along with a roar, the wondrous rock exploded into tiny fragments. Dragon Shisan was finally born, and freed from the shackles of the rock. He roared frenziedly and excitedly. His body continued to enlarge, turning into a giant golden ape in the blink of an eye. He grew to at least a hundred meters in size, almost as huge as a hill.

This was the true Battle Saint Ape. His whole body was full of fur. Each hair of fur was like a sharp needle that could be plucked and used for making divine weapons. There was a golden scale in front of his chest. That was the scale of a dragon. That was the biggest difference between a Battle Dragon Ape and Battle Saint Ape.
“I have come out of the rock at long last. Haha...”
Dragon Shisan continuously hammered his chest and roared excitedly facing the sky. His laughter shook the Heavens and Earth, and lingered and echoed in the void incessantly.

Jiang Chen lifted his head, admitting that the monkey was truly an immemorial leading figure that would be revered by numerous people. The monkey’s body shone with countless golden light. That was the aura of frenzy. The muscle in his arms was like a miniature hill, full of explosive energy. Endless radiance glittered out from his iron staff as though trying to dig an enormous hole in the sky.
This was a peerless great demon, the soul of the Heavens and Earth that had integrated fate and luck with his body.
“Monkey, don’t be too flamboyant. Hurry up and withdraw your giant body!”
Jiang Chen shouted. This bastard seemed to be going too far. His true body was too horrifying and violent.
“Alright!”

Dragon Shisan replied and then his momentum began to drop, his body began to shrink. In a matter of blinks, his hundred meter body shrank to the size of an ordinary man. After that, with a sway of his body, he turned into a human - a youth that seemed as young Jiang Chen, with dark hair fluttering in the air, glittering eyes, and an incomparably good-looking face and a clean yellow robe on his body. He looked like an ordinary young master.

Seeing Dragon Shisan transforming into a human, Jiang Chen staggered, almost having the urge to faint. This bastard appeared to be so decent, looking exactly like a scholar which made it hard to imagine him as a ferocious immemorial battle spirit.
“Call me Brother Shisan from now on.”

Dragon Shisan spoke in an incomparably arrogant tone. Although this bastard had become more handsome, his tone was still as dominating as before. Each of his gesture revealed overbearing aura. Due to the dominance originating from his bones, it could never be concealed. Like Jiang Chen, if he didn’t go berserk, no one would think of this young, handsome man as an unparalleled god of slaughter.
The eyes of Dragon Shisan in particular was incomparably bright. The golden light that flowed out of those increased his divinity.
“Brother Shisan? I think I’d better call you Monkey.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1599 2 - At the sight of Injustice
paragraphs: 6th of the week!
Jiang Chen curled his lips. Although the monkey was now in human form, he was still a monkey by origin. ‘Brother Shisan’ would just be another address to satisfy his narcissism.
“Motherfer! I have finally broken free from the shackles. I have been watching you wreaking havoc in Golden Horizon all this while. I can’t stand it any longer.”
Dragon Shisan kept the iron staff and complained. With such rudeness, it would certainly not conceal his temperament even if he had already changed to a scholarly appearance.
“A wolf in sheep’s clothing. It seems like you’re going to deceive loads of people again.”

Jiang Chen shook his head. This bastard seemed too frail to withstand a gust of wind and could easily be overlooked by enemies because no one would ever think that this vulnerable bastard could explode at any time. Anyone who looked down on him would only suffer misfortune.
“You are also the same: a super freak that has already deceived countless of ignorant eyes.” Dragon Shisan looked disdainfully at Jiang Chen.
These two bastards are the same kind of people. Both were super monstrous freaks, and had a powerful side which people always overlooked.
“That’s my inborn talent. By the way, what’s your cultivation base now? It’s at the intermediate Immortal Emperor right?” Jiang Chen studied Dragon Shisan and spoke.
“That’s true. My current cultivation base is indeed at the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, but those so-called geniuses are as good as dead souls under my iron staff.”

Dragon Shisan spoke domineeringly, but Jiang Chen knew that Dragon Shisan was only making a tentative statement. Given the monkey’s ability, not even the geniuses from the Immortal Court were a match for him. Even the likes of Ye Peng would have to be beaten up pretty badly by Dragon Shisan’s iron staff.
“Alright. Since you’re now born, we should continue to venture Golden Horizon.”

Jiang Chen patted the shoulder of Dragon Shisan, then the two of them took off, heading towards the center of the spatial zone. They had been in this ancient path for quite some time. They could delay no more, otherwise their whole journey would be affected. After all, there was an extremely unique divine medicine in here - the Great Earth Immortal Milk. If they could obtain those nine drops, the benefits would be immeasurable.

The most crucial thing now was to find the entrance to the central most part of the ancient path. That was to find a way through which ancient path was connected to the interior of the vault, as this spatial zone was no longer attractive to Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan. One should know that although the ancient Buddha had built a very strong vault, this place was after all divided into 81 spatial zones. All the treasures and fortunes of the Buddha had been dispersed. As the Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra had appeared in this ancient path, there would be no other treasure in this path anymore. The ancient Buddha wouldn’t place all the treasures in a single spatial zone.

Therefore, Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan headed forward, ignoring any signs of treasures. Obtaining the Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra was already good enough for them. If they didn’t obtain the Heart Sutra, Dragon Shisan would have to wait until the Great Earth Immortal Milk was acquired before he could be born. Now, by relying on the Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra, he was able to leap out of the wondrous rock. To the both of them, this was certainly great news.
*Hong...* *Hong...*

All of a sudden, powerful combat waves spread forward from the void, startling Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan. Those were the waves of combat. Perhaps the battle was still far away, as the combat waves that were radiating didn’t feel very strong, but given the senses of Dragon Shisan, he could clearly feel it.
“Some of them are fighting. Let’s go over and see.” Dragon Shisan spoke.
“They are fighting their own battle. It has nothing to do with me. We’d better stick to our journey,” said Jiang Chen.
There were battles everywhere in Golden Horizon. Jiang Chen wasn’t interested in battles of other people. He was only interested in the Great Earth Immortal Milk.
“Let’s go and have a look. Master Monkey has just been born. I would like to see how the others fight in battle.”
Without caring if Jiang Chen agreed or not, he pulled Jiang Chen’s arm and headed towards the source of the combat waves.
Jiang Chen was speechless, but he understood it. After all, this bastard had just gotten out of the wondrous rock. Any movement outside would be able to attract his interest.
Very quickly, they saw a battlefield ahead. The combat waves intensified.

If one looked closely, there were five silhouettes in front. Four of them were surrounding one person in the middle. The person who was surrounded was precisely the saint girl of Exquisite Paradise, Lan Lingji. Standing in front of her was an evil-looking man in black robe. He was no doubt Hei Lang.

The other three men had eyes that looked empty and blank. They were absolutely the corpse puppets created by Corpse Yin Sect, or rather, the corpse puppets of Hei Lang. Each of them was at the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, just like Hei Lang.
Currently, blood had trickled out of Lan Lingji’s mouth. Her beautiful face had turned pale. Clearly, she had already suffered heavy injuries and was in a real crisis.
“Hei Lang, never thought that you have refined three corpse puppets.”

Lan Lingji spoke coldly. Her combat strength was on par with Hei Lang. Even in a one-versus-one battle, she wouldn’t be concerned about Hei Lang. Even with evil techniques, he wouldn’t be able to defeat her.

But beyond her imagination, Hei Lang possessed three corpse puppets as his trump cards, and each of those corpse puppets had the strength of an intermediate Immortal Emperor realm and were perfectly manipulated by Hei Lang. The three of them worked in harmony, laying an unrivalled siege on Lan Lingji, turning Lan Lingji into a helpless turtle trapped in a jar.
This was still because Lan Linji had strong capabilities. If she was replaced by any other person, that the person would have already been killed by the siege attack quite quickly.

This was the terror of Corpse Yin Sect, and the reason why the others were reluctant to deal with the people of Corpse Yin Sect. Their means were too terrifying. Almost each disciple of Corpse Yin Sect possessed a powerful corpse puppet. In a battle, you wouldn’t fight only the disciple, but also the disciple’s corpse puppet. Hei Lang himself had brought three corpse puppets with him. Any genius of similar level who encountered him would be in bad luck.

*Hong...* *Hong...*
All of a sudden, powerful combat waves spread forward from the void, startling Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan.
Those were the waves of combat.
Perhaps the battle was still far away, as the combat waves that were radiating didn’t feel very strong, but given the senses of Dragon Shisan, he could clearly feel it.
“Some of them are fighting.
Let’s go over and see.” Dragon Shisan spoke.
“They are fighting their own battle.
It has nothing to do with me.
We’d better stick to our journey,” said Jiang Chen.
There were battles everywhere in Golden Horizon.
Jiang Chen wasn’t interested in battles of other people.
He was only interested in the Great Earth Immortal Milk.
“Let’s go and have a look.
Master Monkey has just been born.
I would like to see how the others fight in battle.”
Without caring if Jiang Chen agreed or not, he pulled Jiang Chen’s arm and headed towards the source of the combat waves.
Jiang Chen was speechless, but he understood it.
After all, this bastard had just gotten out of the wondrous rock.
Any movement outside would be able to attract his interest.
Very quickly, they saw a battlefield ahead.
The combat waves intensified.
If one looked closely, there were five silhouettes in front.
Four of them were surrounding one person in the middle.
The person who was surrounded was precisely the saint girl of Exquisite Paradise, Lan Lingji.
Standing in front of her was an evil-looking man in black robe.
He was no doubt Hei Lang.
The other three men had eyes that looked empty and blank.
They were absolutely the corpse puppets created by Corpse Yin Sect, or rather, the corpse puppets of Hei Lang.
Each of them was at the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, just like Hei Lang.
Currently, blood had trickled out of Lan Lingji’s mouth.
Her beautiful face had turned pale.
Clearly, she had already suffered heavy injuries and was in a real crisis.
“Hei Lang, never thought that you have refined three corpse puppets.”
Lan Lingji spoke coldly.
Her combat strength was on par with Hei Lang.
Even in a one-versus-one battle, she wouldn’t be concerned about Hei Lang.
Even with evil techniques, he wouldn’t be able to defeat her.

But beyond her imagination, Hei Lang possessed three corpse puppets as his trump cards, and each of those corpse puppets had the strength of an intermediate Immortal Emperor realm and were perfectly manipulated by Hei Lang.
The three of them worked in harmony, laying an unrivalled siege on Lan Lingji, turning Lan Lingji into a helpless turtle trapped in a jar.
This was still because Lan Linji had strong capabilities.
If she was replaced by any other person, that the person would have already been killed by the siege attack quite quickly.
This was the terror of Corpse Yin Sect, and the reason why the others were reluctant to deal with the people of Corpse Yin Sect.
Their means were too terrifying.
Almost each disciple of Corpse Yin Sect possessed a powerful corpse puppet.
In a battle, you wouldn’t fight only the disciple, but also the disciple’s corpse puppet.
Hei Lang himself had brought three corpse puppets with him.
Any genius of similar level who encountered him would be in bad luck.

chapters.title: Chapter 1600 - A Hero Rescuing a Beauty
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

“*Jie...* *Jie...*... Lan Lingji, I, Hei Lang, have said that you will be my woman sooner or later. Since you refuse to stop resisting me, I have no choice but to use force. This time, I have used all my means and trump cards just to deal with you, which allows you to see my true strength. There are only a few in Corpse Yin Sect that can refine three corpse puppets.”

Hei Lang laughed evilly. His purpose of choosing the same ancient path as Lan Lingji was obvious. He had come for the saint girl. After entering the spatial zone, he had been searching for the trace of Lan Lingji. As for the treasures here, he didn’t have the slightest interest in them. He hated the things of Buddha Sect the most.
Not long after entering, he discovered the qi of Lan Lingji and followed it. After that, it developed into the current scene. This was akin to the saying that says when there’s a will, there’s a way.

Hei Lang’s eyes glinted with greed and desire that reeked of obscenity. In his opinion, Lan Lingji was already his prey. He absolutely wouldn’t let go of such a huge opportunity. The saint girl of Exquisite Paradise was the goddess in the eyes of thousands of men. No one would dare to desecrate this renowned genius of Eastern Profound Domain. But now, this lofty woman was about to fall into his hands and be at his mercy.

To any kind of man, it was a great sense of achievement to possess an unparalleled saint girl like Lan Lingji. In addition to cultivating the evil cultivation law, Hei Lang was also a lascivious man. He had been aroused by Lan Lingji long ago back when they were in Eastern Profound Domain, but because Lan Lingji was the saint girl of Exquisite Paradise, he hadn’t gotten the chance to seize her. Coincidentally he had met her face to face during the expedition in Golden Horizon. This was definitely an opportunity of a lifetime to Hei Lang.
“What a shameless person!”

Lan Lingji’s countenance darkened. Her eyes were full of disgust as she looked at Hei Lang. She even abominated the voice of Hei Lang. As a high and mighty saint girl, and the leading figure of the young generation, she had never been in such a predicament. She was wounded and the battlefield had been completely sealed by Hei Lang and the three corpse puppets. Escaping from here had become somewhat difficult.
“*Jie...* *Jie...*, Lan Lingji, it’s futile to resist anymore. Isn’t it faster and better to surrender to me and become my woman of Hei Lang from now on?”
Hei Lang laughed wickedly, totally not concerning about the disgusted look on Lan Lingji’s face as he just wanted to achieve his own motive.
“Humph! Hei Lang, you think I, Lan Lingji, am that easy to be dealt with? Even if I have to end my life just to stop you today, I won’t let you succeed.”

Lan Lingji harrumphed coldly. She was a spirited young woman. Even if she had to pay the price of her life, she would never let Hei Lang tarnish her image and purity. She would also make sure that Hei Lang would perish with her when the final moment arrived.
“Ending your life to stop me? I’m afraid you won’t have the chance. Lan Lingji, since you refuse to drink a toast and choose to drink forfeit, don’t blame me for my impoliteness.”

Hei Lang’s eyes shone evilly. Under his command, the three corpse puppets let out hoarse roars and lunged at Lan Lingji. The scene today had been fully controlled by Hei Lang. It was impossible for Lan Lingji to escape from the scene.

Lan Lingji’s facial expression changed slightly. A blue sword had appeared in her hand. It was an incomparably divine-looking sword that glittered a blue-coloured light. In an instant, she had entangled herself in an intense battle with the three corpse puppets. It was much scarier to fight more than one corpse puppet, especially more so when the corpse puppets had joined forces with their master. Just like now, under the manipulation of Hei Lang, the cooperation between the three corpse puppets had reached perfection. As Lan Lingji had suffered a certain degree of injury, she appeared to be inferior in battle and could fall into a critical situation at any time.
*Barf...*
Not long after that, Lan Lingji spurted out a mouthful of blood. Her face turned even more unpleasant.
“Lan Linji, today, you won’t be able to escape even if you have a pair of wings. You will become my woman. Haha...”
Hei Lang laughed smugly and was determined not to give Lan Lingji a single chance.
“Don’t even think about it.”

Lan Lingji’s ardent nature had been completely ignited. Flames blazed in her beautiful eyes. She looked as if she was going mad. Energy began to churn terrifyingly inside of her. Today, she wouldn’t let Hei Lang succeed even if that meant making the ultimate sacrifice.
*Hong Long...*
The battle was extremely fierce. As the saint girl of Exquisite Paradise, she did have some powerful means, but it didn’t seem like she could last any longer.
This scene was coincidentally seen by Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan. Before Jiang Chen could react to it, Dragon Shisan responded.
“Motherfer! All of them bullied a single woman? What kind of people are they? I totally disapprove of such action!” said Dragon Shisan, infuriated.

“Hei Lang should die. The grudges between me and Corpse Yin Sect can never be resolved. Since we have met today, I’m going to kill Hei Lang. Moreover, as I have no grudges against Exquisite Paradise, I may be able to befriend them if I save their saint girl. Having a friend is always better than having another enemy.” Jiang Chen said. His qi fluctuated, ready to strike.

“Let me do this. Regarding matters about a hero rescuing a girl, you better stand aside. Don’t be a busybody since you already have so many wives. Leave one for your brother.” Dragon Shisan grabbed Jiang Chen’s arm and spoke cunningly.
“Haha! So it turns out that you are interested in the saint girl, but I wonder if she will be interested in you, stupid monkey.”

Jiang Chen laughed loudly. Being a gentleman who never seize what others loved, Jiang Chen would naturally leave this opportune moment to the monkey. After all, he didn’t have any feelings for Lan Lingji.

This was a good opportunity for Dragon Shisan. Not only could he test his abilities, but also show his abilities to a stunning woman that was coveted by thousands of men. It was very normal for the monkey to like her.
“Damn! You have already seen through it. That means we won’t be brothers anymore.” Dragon Shisan darted Jiang Chen a glare.
“You better strike quickly, Lan Lingji won’t be able to hold on any longer.” Jiang Chen warned.
“Master Monkey has come!”

Dragon Shisan rushed out. The golden iron staff materialized in his hand, looking high and mighty. Don’t be deceived by the scholarly look of this bastard, once a battle was started, his momentum as a Battle Saint Ape would be unveiled.

On the battlefield, Lan Lingji was wounded repeatedly. Her eyes went fierce. She was ready to perish along with her enemies when an incredibly powerful silhouette suddenly intruded into the battlefield and came to her side.
“Pretty girl, Brother Shisan has come to save you.” Dragon Shisan gave a flirting wink at Lan Lingji.

Lan Lingji was stunned. She never thought that someone would emerge at this crucial moment, but she remained indifferent towards the wink given by Dragon Shisan. If it was during normal days, anyone who dared to wink at her this way would surely taste her slap.
“Who is it?”

Hei Lang looked towards Dragon Shisan, feeling somewhat astonished because this battlefield was already sealed by the three corpse puppets. Any ordinary experts wouldn’t be able to enter this space. However, this kid was able to break into here with ease. It only showed that this intruder wasn’t an average expert.

But when Hei Lang saw that the intruder only had the cultivation base of an intermediate Immortal Emperor, he heaved a relief in his heart. As long as the opponent wasn’t a late Immortal Emperor like Ye Peng, he wouldn’t put the opponent in his eyes. Given his means and techniques, any opponent below late Immortal Emperor wouldn’t concern him at all.
“I’m Dragon Shisan. Hei Lang. Why the hell are you and your pricks bullying a girl here?” Dragon Shisan cursed in his introduction, totally not giving Hei Lang the slightest face.

“Haha! It seems like a hero is trying to rescue a beauty. Kid, you are too impulsive. Why didn’t you measure your own capabilities before acting? Since you have come, then you can die together with her.”
Hei Lang laughed complacently. With his control, the three corpse puppets lunged at Dragon Shisan simultaneously.
“Be careful. These corpse puppets are very powerful and cooperate with one another very well.” Lan Lingji hastily reminded.
“They should be the ones to be careful. Eat my iron staff!” Dragon Shisan lifted his iron staff and struck it at one of the corpse puppets in lighting speed.
*Bang!*
It was too fast and had the pressure of a mountain. Even under the precise control of Hei Lang, the corpse puppet still couldn’t avoid this strike.
The strike had accurately hit the head of the corpse. Its solid body exploded in an instant and turned to dust.
“What?”

Hei Lang and Lan Lingji yelled at the same time, completely changing the way they looked at Dragon Shisan. Both of them knew the terror of the corpse puppet too well. It was personally refined and created by Hei Lang. And as Lan Lingji had been severely wounded by the corpse puppets, she naturally knew how scary those things were, but Dragon Shisan had eliminated one of them with a simple swing of his iron staff. The whole process was as simple as crushing an ant.
This was definitely not an accident, because such an accident would never take place. The only explanation for this was that this bastard was too powerful.
“Who are you?” Hei Lang’s tone turned grim.
“Someone you can’t afford to offend.”

Dragon Shisan’s eyes shot out divine light. His dark hair flowed in the breeze. The iron staff in his hand glittered like an invincible divine weapon. Without another word, he thrust the iron staff at another corpse puppet.
*Bang!*

Just like earlier, although the mighty corpse puppet was at the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, it couldn’t even stand a chance under the iron staff of Dragon Shisan and was struck to death, turning into powder.
Before Hei Lang could react, Dragon Shisan swung his iron staff to the last corpse puppet.
“Stop!”

Hei Lang was alarmed. He couldn’t dare to delay anymore. Hastily, he hurtled forward, hoping to seize the corpse puppet before Dragon Shisan, because only he knew how much effort and price he had paid in order to refine his corpse puppets.

chapters.title: Chapter 1601 - Let’s be friends
paragraphs: Another 5 PUBLIC BONUS CHAPTERS! This will be the third last mass release for the public.

Hei Lang realized that this seemingly bookish guy was very unusual, but it was already too late for him to seize the corpse puppet over. Whether it was strength or speed, he was no match for Dragon Shisan.
*Bang!*

Dragon Shisan didn’t take Hei Lang seriously. He didn’t even glance at the swooping Hei Lang before striking violently on the last corpse puppet’s head. Without accident, the last corpse puppet’s end was similar to the previous two, it was crushed by Dragon Shisan’s iron staff.
“Son of a b*tch!”

Hei Lang was angered. Another incomparably cold black blade appeared in his hand, and swung it at Dragon Shisan. Dragon Shisan casually raised his iron staff, colliding with Hei Lang’s big blade. One could only feel the scariness of Dragon Shisan after fighting him. Hei Lang could feel the surging energy released from Dragon Shisan’s body. That was the energy of destruction that could burst out at any moment. Even if he exhaust all of his techniques, he was still no match for him. There was an unimaginable gap between them.
*Keng!*

As the big blade slashed on the iron staff, Hei Lang felt a huge repulsive force and was sent flying a hundred meters away while spurting out blood on the way. It was merely a simple move of Dragon Shisan, but it had already severely injured Hei Lang, giving him no chance of resisting.
“You think a trash like you is qualified enough to fight Master Monkey? You are too unaware of your own limitations.”

Dragon Shisan looked at Hei Lang contemptuously. That was an inborn haughtiness, Dragon Shisan had all the right to be haughty, however. A trash like Hei Lang was certainly not qualified to be Dragon Shisan’s opponent. Both of them were at two totally different levels.

Lan Lingji’s jaw remained opened for a long time. She was frozen. Her eyes glinted with a strange expression. As the saint girl of Exquisite Paradise, she had seen countless of geniuses, but none of them were as ferocious as Dragon Shisan. She knew the strength of Hei Lang very well as she had just fought him a moment ago and almost lost her life. This youth also had an intermediate Immortal Emperor cultivation base, but the difference between the two was just too great. She was able to clearly see that the mighty Hei Lang couldn’t even stand a chance in front of Dragon Shisan.
This monstrous genius comes from which major power? How can he be this powerful?

Lan Lingji’s heart was shaken, at the same time, she couldn’t help being fascinated and attracted by the demeanour of Dragon Shisan. A powerful man could always attract a woman. Furthermore, Dragon Shisan was her lifesaver. This alone gave her a good reason to not hate him.
It was very hard for an unparalleled saint girl like Lan Lingji to really pay attention to a man, but now, the actions of Dragon Shisan was branded in her eyes.
“Who-who are you exactly?”

Hei Lang asked viciously. After losing three corpse puppets, he had suffered a huge blow. Those were his life and blood, and they were destroyed just like that. Only he knew how much he hated Dragon Shisan now. If there was a chance to kill Dragon Shisan, he would never let Dragon Shisan die so easily.
Unfortunately, he also knew that it was virtually impossible to have this revenge because the opponent was just too powerful. It was already considered not bad if he could survive today.
“Someone who wants your life.”
Dragon Shisan was reluctant to speak anymore, held the iron staff and lunged at Hei Lang. With extreme speed, he appeared in front of Hei Lang in the blink of an eye.
“Wait!”

Hei Lang was scared to death. Today, he had encountered someone who was even more vicious than him, who wouldn’t even give him the slightest face before making a move. He was truly in bad luck today. If the iron staff were to strike on his head, he would most likely be struck to death just like the previous three corpse puppets.
“What else do you want to say? Quickly say it,” said Dragon Shisan.

“Don’t kill me. You and I aren’t enemies to begin with. As long as you let me go, I guarantee that I won’t cause you any more trouble. I’m the most important genius of Corpse Yin Sect. Killing me won’t do you any good.”

Hei Lang was trembling with fear. All along, it was him who killed his opponents. He had never felt the feeling of death. Now, he could already smell the taste of death which was as scary and as cold as an icy cave. He didn’t want to die. How could a genius with high reputation and power in Corpse Yin Sect be willing to die? He still hadn’t gotten the Great Earth Immortal Milk yet.
“You are right.” Dragon Shisan nodded and mused deliberately.

Upon seeing this, Hei Lang’s face immediately revealed a look of surprise. It seemed like his identity in Corpse Yin Sect had some effect on his persuasion, and had successfully deterred his killer. As long as he could escape today, he would surely have his revenge in the future.
“Good. As long as you don’t kill me, we can still be friends.” Hei Lang hastily added.
“Young Master Dragon, don’t believe in what this man is saying. This man is cunning and crafty. Keeping him alive will only breed disaster.” Lan Lingji said.
“You are right. Killing you won’t bring me any benefits, but someone is going to gain benefits after killing you.”
Dragon Shisan nodded, then turned to Jiang Chen who was watching from afar and shouted. “Little Chen, come and kill him!”

Hei Lang’s words had undoubtedly reminded Dragon Shisan of something. Dragon Shisan would never be kind enough to let him go. As he knew that he didn’t have any brocade pouch, killing Hei Lang wouldn’t benefit him. If Jiang Chen killed Hei Lang, the scenario would be different. Jiang Chen could straightaway get the pouch from Hei Lang. Whether there was treasure in Hei Lang’s brocade pouch or not, his luck would absolutely be absorbed by Jiang Chen.

Upon hearing this, Lan Lingji and Hei Lang swivelled around towards where Dragon Shisan was yelling at and saw a youth in white-robe, walking towards them in a light pace with one hand behind his back.
The corners of Jiang Chen’s mouth revealed a slight smile. Without speaking another word, the Heavenly Saint Sword materialized in his hand, he thrust the sword into Hei Lang’s skull.
“He’s right. I will have loads of benefits by killing you,” said Jiang Chen. The Heavenly Saint Sword went into Hei Lang’s forehead. Blood poured out with red brilliance.
“You-you...”

She knew that she didn’t hate Dragon Shisan and felt quite happy despite the frivolous behaviour of Dragon Shisan. She told herself that this was mostly because of the fact that Dragon Shisan had saved her life, but the truth was perhaps more than this.
“Young Master Dragon has saved Lingji. We can naturally be friends.”
Lan Lingji recovered from her state very quickly. After all, she was the saint girl of Exquisite Paradise. Her disposition was incomparable to ordinary people.
Furthermore, she was even more shocked by Dragon Shisan’s strength. She found it extremely unusual that she had never heard of such a terrifying and unparalleled genius before.
As for Jiang Chen, she had heard a lot about him, but Jiang Chen only had the cultivation base of an Immortal King. Therefore, the one that intrigued her the most was Dragon Shisan.
“I wonder if Miss Lan has obtained any treasures from this space?” Jiang Chen asked.
“Not yet. There seems to be no treasures and dangers in this spatial zone.”
Lan Lingji shook her head. She naturally didn’t know that the greatest danger and treasure of this place had already been encountered by Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1602 - The Buddha’s Relic
paragraphs: “This is normal. After all, there are 81 ancient routes here. Our luck isn’t considered bad. Although there are no treasures here, at least there are no dangers. We should seek for the centre of the immortal vault now. If someone arrived there earlier than us, I’m afraid the Great Earth Immortal Milk will be gone.” Jiang Chen spoke.

“You’re right. Why don’t we go there together?” Lan Lingji suggested. She still had injuries in her body and needed some time to recover. Joining forces with Dragon Shisan and Jiang Chen would undoubtedly be beneficial to her.
“Alright. We’ll go together then.” Dragon Shisan immediately nodded. This was what he had been wishing for.
The death of Hei Lang was a kind of harvest to them and was equivalent to the elimination of a strong enemy.
Jiang Chen, Dragon Shisan and Lan Lingji, the three of them headed towards the centre of the immortal vault. By joining forces, the trio was virtually invincible in entire Golden Horizon.

Obviously, this spatial zone didn’t have any more good treasures. What they needed to do now was to go to the centermost part of the vault to seek for the Great Earth Immortal Milk which Jiang Chen was still very interested in. Although he had already advanced to the late Immortal King realm, the number of dragon marks in his body just reached 1 200 000 and his cultivation base wasn’t considered stable yet. If he was able to acquire the Great Earth Immortal Milk, his strength would surely be enhanced once more. When that time came, he would be able to act without fear.
Meanwhile, in another ancient path of the spatial zone, Tyrant had also discovered an ancient palace that was as battered and dilapidated as the one that Jiang Chen found.

It was located in an illusory and insubstantial land. It was very difficult for people to see it, but due to Tyrant having deep affinity with Buddha, his ability to sense the inheritance of Buddha was a lot sharper than ordinary people.
Similarly, the entrance of the palace was blocked by a formation. Due to it having existed for a long time, it had become old and vulnerable. To Tyrant, breaking this formation was just too simple.
“Amitabha.”

Tyrant put his hands together. Pure Buddha Radiance appeared from his body and rushed towards the ancient palace. As though sensing the qi of Tyrant, the formation outside the ancient palace crumbled and the entrance opened automatically, as if this ancient palace was specially left for him.

Upon seeing this, Tyrant couldn’t help but reveal a hint of delight, but he also felt a trace of grief. After all, a powerful ancient Buddha Venerable had fallen here. As the descendant of Buddha Sect, he naturally wouldn’t feel good about it.

Regaining his senses, he began to stride towards the ancient palace. As this ancient palace seemed to have opened itself for him, there might be a fortune waiting for him inside. So naturally he wouldn’t let go of the chance. He had yet to break through to the Immortal Emperor realm and was still at the peak of half-step Immortal Emperor realm, but he was already infinitely close to the true Immortal Emperor realm. What he lacked now was a chance to make the breakthrough.
Speaking of breakthrough, Tyrant should have the biggest chance of obtaining the inheritance of the Buddha Venerable amongst all the geniuses.

As soon as he reached the interior of the palace, golden Buddha Radiance rushed out. For an instant, the dark palace had brightened up all of a sudden. The inside of the palace turned golden and the characters of Sanskrit that were drifting in the air looked tremendously divine.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

The void trembled. A golden round ball the size of a fist floated back and forth in the sky, and then bobbing down in the front of Tyrant. Looking closely at the round ball, there were lines of divine Buddha Sanskrit on its surface. There seemed to have been an old eminent monk sitting cross-legged with a solemn face at the centre of the ball.
This was the peerless and the supreme Buddha. He looked like the legendary ancient Arhat. A casual movement from him radiated the pure qi of Buddha Sect.
“The Buddha’s Relic.”

Tyrant’s eyes perked up. This was the relic of Buddha Sect. It was the essence of the ancient Buddha Venerable’s life. The fist-sized relic was the biggest relic Tyrant had ever seen in his life. Judging from the qi emanating out from it, it should be left by a Great Buddha of at least late Immortal Venerable realm.

He gulped a mouthful of saliva with difficulty, and was rooted to the spot. This piece of relic was a truly peerless treasure. The Great Earth Immortal Milk became worthless to mention compared to this treasure. To a disciple of Buddha Sect like Tyrant, he would definitely obtain immeasurable benefits from this relic.

He lightly stuck out his hand, then realized that his hand was shaking. As his palm was about to touch the relic, he hastily withdrew it. He felt that it was really disrespectful to treat the inheritance of an ancient Buddha Venerable in such a way.
“Amitabha. Disciple is Tyrant. Disciple feels very fortunate and grateful to be able to obtain the inheritance of Buddha Venerable.”
Tyrant put his palms together and bowed deeply to the relic three times before extending his hand again.
A relic was the life essence and a true inheritance of a Great Buddha. Anyone who acquired the inheritance of a Great Buddha would surely skyrocket to the top.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

As Tyrant held the relic, the relic immediately bounded intensely. It wasn’t resistance but recognition and excitement, as though it had been reserved specifically for Tyrant. It couldn’t be helped. Tyrant’s affinity with Buddha was too deep. That was why he attracted the attention of the relic.

A relic of this type had its own spirituality. Even if it were to be placed here for a longer period of time, its spirituality wouldn’t disappear. It would never appear if it didn’t meet the right wielder. In other words, if it wasn’t Tyrant who appeared in this ancient palace, it was afraid that the relic would be less likely to emerge.

One had to say that the ancient Buddha who left behind this inheritance was incomparably wise. He had used the nine drops of Great Earth Immortal Milk as lure and bait to attract everyone’s attention. In truth, the treasures that he was truly concerned of were this relic and the Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra.

Needless to say, the relic contained the life essence and effort of the Buddha Venerable, comprising almost all of his inheritances. The Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra was also a supreme heart technique inherited from the Great Unrestrained Ancient Buddha. Its value could never be valued with price.

This was the great opportunity of Tyrant. This relic alone made his trip to Golden Horizon worthwhile as its weight was just too great. If he had refined it, no one could tell to what extent his cultivation base would grow.
Warmth and ancient aura began to spread in his hand, giving him a sense of familiarity.
Without hesitation, he wheeled and turned the doors of the palace, sat cross-legged and began refining the relic.
“By refining the relic, my cultivation base shouldn’t have trouble advancing to the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm within a short period of time.”

Tyrant was incomparably excited. He knew that his current cultivation base was too weak to survive in Golden Horizon. There were too many geniuses and he could easily find an Immortal Emperor amongst them. With this piece of relic, he was certain that he could boost his cultivation base in a short amount of time. While being in Golden Horizon that was full of danger, strength was always the most important thing.
Note:

chapters.title: Chapter 1603 - The ringing of the bell that was ten thousand years ago
paragraphs: This was the inheritance and legacy left behind by a late Immortal Venerable. No one could estimate the value of this relic. Even Tyrant himself couldn’t gauge how much benefits this relic would bring to him. Besides, he was now in a state of thrill.
I wonder if Little Chen, Big Yellow and Sister Ning have come into this immortal vault. Anyway, I will have to advance my cultivation base first before I go looking for them.

Tyrant muttered. He had met his Senior Brother Hao Ran before this, and was told that Jiang Chen and Big Yellow had come to the Golden Horizon as well. Monk Hao Ran also said that there was a black-clad girl standing next to Jiang Chen. It went without saying that she was Wu Ningzhu. This news had delighted him as the brothers could reunite and fight side by side again.
If Jiang Chen was in this immortal vault, perhaps he would have the chance to meet him. After all, the Golden Horizon was just too huge. It was truly difficult to meet someone you know here.

After getting the relic, he already lost interest in all the other treasures in the immortal vault. Even the Great Earth Immortal Milk was no longer attractive to him. To him, the value of the relic transcended everything. Not even the Great Earth Immortal Milk could be compared to it.

But he had to advance his cultivation base as soon as possible, then enter into the centremost part of the immortal vault to where the nine drops of Great Earth Immortal Milk was located. Despite his lack of interest in the precious liquid, he was certain that Jiang Chen would be very interested in it. If Jiang Chen really entered this immortal vault, he would definitely seek for the Great Earth Immortal Milk. So in order for him to meet Jiang Chen, he would need to get to the centre of the vault.

On the other side, Jiang Chen and the other two had arrived at the end of the ancient path, there were also other geniuses looking around, trying to find the entrance to the centre of the immortal vault, but to no avail.
“What’s going on? We have already reached the end of the path. Why is there no access to the centre of the vault? Could it be that we have been tricked by the old monk?”

“There’s eighty percent chance that we have been tricked. The old monk said that each path of the 81 ancient paths contained treasures and dangers, but we have come all the way to here peacefully without discovering any treasures. We didn’t even encounter any danger. Not even an evil spirit has emerged. It was just like a pointless wander.”
“Don’t talk anymore. I’m afraid that this ancient path isn’t as simple as we had imagined. We should continue to look for the passageway once more.”

The people were distressed. They began to have lesser respect towards the Buddha Venerable. Some started to call him old monk. As a matter of fact, they had grown depressed along the journey of this ancient path. After reading the words on the stone slab, they felt that this ancient path must have rare treasures. Even if there weren’t great treasures, there had to be at least some high grade Immortal Meta Stones or some sort of immortal weapons. Unexpectedly, they had gotten nothing even though they had reached the end of the path.

This might not be the most depressing thing. The thing that depressed them the most was that they didn’t even encounter a single evil creature. Where were the treasures that were mentioned? How about the dangers? If they weren’t being tricked, then what would it be?

Listening to the complaints of these people, Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan couldn’t help but smile. There were only the two of them who looked the happiest, because all the treasures and dangers of this spatial zone had been met by them.

The encounter with the evil creatures had allowed Jiang Chen to repair the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda and allowed the pagoda to reach thirty-eighth and half level. The thirty-ninth level was going to be fully condensed soon. His cultivation base had also advanced to the late Immortal King realm. The Great Unrestrained Heart Sutra had expedite the birth of Dragon Shisan, breaking free from the shackles of the wondrous rock.

However, if these were to be mentioned, the eyes of these people alone would surely devour the two. Of course, it was impossible for the two of them to mention this to any one of them, as the saying went, the real freedom was to make a fortune in silence.

In truth, amongst all the geniuses, Lan Lingji was the most depressed one. Not only had she gotten nothing, she was almost captured by Hei Lang. If Dragon Shisan didn’t come to her rescue at the most critical moment, she wouldn’t know what the outcome would be.
“Why isn’t there an entrance? Could it be that we have to return to where we came from?” Lan Lingji too, frowned.
“We’ll just wait and see. It’s impossible for us to go back to where we came from as the path has already been closed. I’m afraid that there’s no going back,” said Jiang Chen.
As soon as Jiang Chen finished speaking, the void ahead trembled all of a sudden. Then, an illusory channel roared and appeared in front of their eyes.
“It’s the passageway that lead to the centre of the vault. I never thought it will activate on its own.”
“Haha! I thought that we had been tricked. Let’s go. This passageway will bring us to the centre, to where the Great Earth Immortal Milk is.”
“What are you all waiting for? Go now. If someone else reaches there first, I’m afraid we won’t be able to get any share of the precious liquid.”

The sudden appearance of the channel excited everyone who was irritated just moments ago. One by one, they rushed towards the channel. After all, they hadn’t gotten anything in the ancient path and wasn’t feeling very good. They were eager to be the first to reach the centre of the vault as they were certain that the treasures there would be extraordinary. If they could obtain some of it, their trip here would be worth it.

In a matter of a few blinks, all of them entered the illusory passageway. Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan exchanged a glance. Without delay, the three of them swayed and vanished into the channel. As Lan Lingji had almost recovered from her injuries, a casual movement from her radiated the demeanour and bearing of a saint girl.

The illusory passageway was very short. It ended almost in the blink of an eye. When Jiang Chen and the rest walked out of it, they saw silhouettes emerging from different directions. They were coming out from different ancient paths. For a moment, at least a thousand geniuses had appeared in this spatial zone and the number was still increasing.

There was a hint of consternation on everyone’s face. Obviously, this situation was beyond their imagination. Many of them were thinking of the same thing - be the first to get in so that they could seize the treasure, but now, it seemed like their plan had failed.

However, none on the scene was an idiot. Very quickly, they understood the key of this situation. Clearly, the passageway of the 81 ancient paths were opened at the same time. Before it was opened, numerous people had already been waiting like Jiang Chen and company at the end of their respective ancient paths. This explained why so many had appeared as soon as the passageway was opened. This was the only explanation.
“It seems like many have died in their way here.” Said Lan Lingji.

Anyone was able to discern this. From the beginning, there were nearly 3000 people who entered the vault. Now, there were only a thousand of them. Taking into account those who were coming in and still in the ancient paths, there were only 2000 of them at most. That was to say, nearly 1000 geniuses had died in the 81 ancient paths.

This was undeniably cruel, but anyone who decided to step into Golden Horizon knew the dangers and cruelty co-existed together, and must be prepared to die. Death could occur at any time. There were battles between humans and evil creatures, and the presence of other dangers in this place. It was a place of ancient battlefield, a place of war.

Therefore, it was very normal for 1000 people to die along the way. A dozen of them had already died in the path that Jiang Chen picked. Of course, they didn’t die in the hands of evil creatures. All of them were killed by Jiang Chen. Even if the other ancient paths didn’t have someone as powerful as Jiang Chen, they should have encountered some powerful evil creatures, unlike in Jiang Chen’s path where all the evil creatures were turned into nourishment of the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda. If the hundreds of evil creatures in Jiang Chen’s path weren’t eliminated earlier, no one knew how much more geniuses would die along the way.

“Motherfer! The old monk does know how to play tricks. He has tricked us all even though he has already passed away. All of the passageways are opened simultaneously. Even if there is a Great Earth Immortal Milk, it’s going to be a fierce fight.”

“That’s true. Look, even Ye Peng is here. Who’s able to compete with him? And there are those peerless geniuses of some major powers and also the saint girl of Exquisite Paradise, and a few other intermediate Immortal Emperor geniuses. We won’t stand a chance in their presence.”
“Well, that’s not necessarily true. Even if we can’t get the Great Earth Immortal Milk, we may still able to get some other treasures. We can’t just go back with empty hands.”

Plenty of them with weaker strength began to feel slightly disheartened. This wasn’t the result they expected and was the last thing they wanted to see. With so many experts here, it had become even harder for them to obtain any treasure, but most of them revealed ruthlessness in their eyes. Since they had already come here, they couldn’t let themselves return empty-handed. Even if the competition was fierce, they couldn’t give up just like that.
*Dang...* *Dang...* *Dang...*

Suddenly, the ring of a bell sounded from ahead. It was the ringing of a very ancient bell. As the ringing was heard, the whole world seemed to quiet down. All the noises had been replaced by silence. Then, a large golden light emerged in front. It was the dazzling Buddha Radiance.
“This is the ringing of an ancient bell. But these are residual waves of the ringing left behind ten thousand years ago. It’s an echo.” Dragon Shisan said.
“The echo that was left behind ten thousand years ago? I wouldn’t dare to imagine it.” Lan Lingji said with a sigh.
“There’s an ancient temple ahead. The Great Earth Immortal Milk is just ahead.”
Someone roared, stirring everyone into motion. Each of them shouted excitedly and flew towards the ancient temple with their fastest speed possible, fearing that they might be late than the others.

“The ancient temple has already existed for countless years. It must be left behind by the ancient Buddha. It should be the place that holds his true inheritance. The nine drops of Great Earth Immortal Milk should be inside. Let’s go over as well,” said Jiang Chen.
Then, the trio flew towards the direction where everyone was going. That was the centre most part of the immortal vault.
