chapters.title: Chapter 1627 - The Annihilation of the City
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

Although this man seemed pompous, he had a strong cultivation base. He had already reached the terrifying late Immortal Emperor realm. By his side stood another late Immortal Emperor. Dragon Shisan had discerned their cultivation base and knew that Yan Yulong must be one of them.
“Who’s Yan Yulong?” Dragon Shisan asked indifferently.
“I am. You know me?”

The youth that held the folding fan stared at Dragon Shisan with a forceful gaze. His eyes were filled with unconcealed fury. He couldn’t believe that this intruder had come here specifically for him.

Dragon Shisan swept around and discovered that there were approximately twenty people on the scene. Including the dozen that had been injured and killed by him, there’s still another dozen left who’s guarding the dungeon below at the moment, but as long as there weren’t late Immortal Emperors among them, no one would be able to stop Lan Lingji. So she wouldn’t have a problem at all in rescuing the captives.

Today, Dragon Shisan’s movement had completely drawn the attention of almost all disciples of All Pleasure Sect, including Yan Yulong and the other late Immortal Emperor expert. No one would expect that someone would try to sneak into the dungeon at this time.
“It seems like most of you are already here. Tell me now, do you all want to die or be an eunuch like them?”

Dragon Shisan asked, as though he was asking a reasonable question. Judging by his looks, it seemed as if he had conquered the entire All Pleasure Sect, and all of the disciples of the sect would die without a doubt.
“What an extremely conceited man! It’s been very long since someone spoke to me in such a tone. You are just a puny little intermediate Immortal Emperor that knows nothing about life and death.”

The late Immortal Emperor next to Yan Yulong spoke coldly. He made a step forward. His body was full of cold killing intent. His appearance was incomparably attractive, but there’s a disgusting qi emitted from him. At least, he was the kind of person that Dragon Shisan hated. In fact, Dragon Shisan hated every disciple of All Pleasure Sect.
“You people of All Pleasure Sect are truly disgusting. Who gave you all the permission to touch the disciples of Exquisite Paradise and Celestial Flower Valley?” Dragon Shisan spoke coldly.

“It turns out that you have come for the ladies. It’s a pity. If you didn’t attack, I might’ve given you the chance to join our sect and enjoy those angels, but now, you won’t have that chance anymore. After injuring so many of our sect’s disciples, you won’t die enough even if you have 10 lives.” Yan Yulong spoke coldly, flapping the fan in front of his chest.
“I have no interest in your All Pleasure Sect. But, I really want to see if you’re all enough for me to kill.” Dragon Shisan raised his iron staff and aimed at Yan Yulong provocatively.
“Kill him.”

Yan Yulong closed his fan with a flap. Two rays of cold light shot out from his eyes as he gave the order to the late Immortal Emperor standing beside him. Although the man next to Yan Yulong was also a late Immortal Emperor, he wouldn’t dare show any neglect towards Yan Yulong’s order. Clearly, Yan Yulong was the one in charge here.
“Roger.”

The disciple’s qi fluctuated and instantly struck out a huge hand at Dragon Shisan aggressively. Upon seeing this, Dragon Shisan shook his head. The unstable qi of this man indicated that he had just advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm not long ago. As such, there was an enormous gap between him and Ye Peng. When Dragon Shisan killed Ye Peng, he only sent out three strikes, but to kill this son of a b*tch, he only needed one strike!
“A reckless and impulsive bastard.”
Dragon Shisan wore a cold smile. His movement was pretty simple. He lifted the iron staff and smashed ferociously at the disciple.

A violent void-breaking wind that sounded like the angry roars of frenzied dragons swept through the scene. The void was instantly broken into two halves. The energy emitted from the iron staff interwove into a giant net and enveloped the disciple, making it impossible for him to escape.
“Not good!”

That disciple wasn’t a fool. He immediately felt the terrifying qi of oppression from Dragon Shisan’s body. That was an extremely dangerous qi. He was certain that it could threaten his life, however it was already too late to escape now, so he could only face the attack head-on.
*Hong Long...*
The iron staff was indestructible. The attack of the disciple was shattered to pieces as soon as it collided with the iron staff, and then, the iron staff hit the skull of the disciple.

The late Immortal Emperor let out a miserable scream. His skull burst into a mist of blood as the iron staff smashed it, leaving his headless body falling to the ground. The gap between the two of them was just too great. Although the disciple was a late Immortal Emperor, his foundation was too weak, or it should be said that his foundation hadn’t even stabilized after he obtained the treasure in the ancient city. He could only be considered to be slightly stronger than a peak intermediate Immortal Emperor expert. There was no way he could be compared to Ye Peng.

Furthermore, due to this expert having looked down on Dragon Shisan, he didn’t exert his full strength. It was already too late when he realized his mistake. That was why he was beaten to death by a single blow even before he could put up a resistance.
“What?”

The scene made Yan Yulong exclaim. His calm expression suddenly turned incomparably ugly. Although his junior brother’s cultivation base and combat strength weren’t as strong as his, his junior brother was still a late Immortal Emperor, whereas the opponent was only an intermediate Immortal Emperor. Nevertheless, his junior brother had been killed by just a single blow. If he didn’t see this with his own eyes, he would never believe it.
“How could this happen? Why is this bastard so powerful? Senior Brother Liu is a supreme late Immortal Emperor, how could he not defeat an intermediate Immortal Emperor?”

“Is this man a peerless talent? He’s so powerful that he can kill Senior Brother Liu in just one strike. What do we do now? He may be an abnormal genius from some major power or a super genius from the Immortal Court. Otherwise, he won’t be this powerful. It seems like not even Senior Brother Yan will be a match for him as well.”

“Dammit! Why would a malefic person come to our territory? But we don’t have to fear him. Senior Brother Yan has very powerful means and is very much stronger compared to Senior Brother Liu. There’s no problem for him to eradicate the enemy. If worst comes to worst, we will join forces and fight him. With so many of us here, I don’t believe we can’t beat him.”

Each of the disciples of All Pleasure Sect was astounded. Such a scene was something they hadn’t even dreamt of. In their opinions, having two late Immortal Emperors in their sect would’ve allowed them to roam freely and commit all manner of evils in Golden Horizon, but now, their confidence and sense of superiority were vanishing rapidly because of the sudden emergence of this yellow-robed youth.

“There’s no need to be surprised. This is only the beginning. Since this ancient city has already been conquered by All Pleasure Sect, there’s no need for this city to continue existing anymore. All of you will have to die. None of you can escape,” Dragon Shisan spoke coldly.
Killing these people was just like killing insects to him. It couldn’t even cause the slightest stimulation in his thoughts.
Meanwhile, in the dungeon.

A dozen disciples of All Pleasure Sect stood in the entrance of the dungeon. It was a very huge and cold dungeon. There were more than twenty people being held captive in here. All of them were pretty girls, but their faces weren’t looking good. Some were lying paralyzed on the ground, powerless.

All Pleasure Sect had a type of medicine that could temporarily make the consumer lose her combat strength. These female disciples of Exquisite Paradise and Celestial Flower Valley had obviously been poisoned by this type of medicine. Among these girls, there was one who was dressed in white and seemed in her twenties. Despite her slightly pale face, her figure was attractive and her face was exquisite. Although the other girls also had the same features, they suddenly became inferior when compared to that girl.
Although this girl seemed slightly inferior to Lan Lingji, she was a rare angel of the world. She was precisely the saintess of Celestial Flower Valley.

At this moment, there were a dozen disciples of All Pleasure Sect guarding the outside of the dungeon. However these disciples didn’t look too good, because they were informed about the situation outside. There were two intermediate Immortal Emperors amongst them, the strongest remaining disciples in the dungeon. They were able to observe the situation outside.
“What’s the background of that yellow-robed youth? Why is he so powerful? Even Senior Brother Liu died in his hands. He has made our sect suffer incredible loss.”
“Truly inconceivable! He has come for the girls. In my opinion, let’s just use these girls to threaten him. I believe that it can certainly minimize our loses.”

“Don’t be too worried first. Senior Brother Yan hasn’t fought yet. His powerful means are incomparable to Senior Brother Liu. I believe that Senior Brother Yan can surely deal with that yellow-robed youth. After all, that person is only an intermediate Immortal Emperor.”

“That’s right. Senior Brother Liu was too impulsive and underestimated his enemy, which caused him to die in the enemy’s hands. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be impossible for Senior Brother Liu to be killed.”

The dozen men gave their own remarks. They were crystal clear about the situation outside. The yellow-robed youth had dealt a very strong blow to their hearts that they could hardly accept it. Now, the only thing they could do was to keep a close eye at these girls while waiting for their Senior Brother Yan to kill the enemy. If even Senior Brother Yan wasn’t a match for the enemy, these girls were going to be their last resort.

“The few of you go and watch after those girls. Once the situation isn’t in our favour, immediately pull all the girls out,” one of the intermediate Immortal Emperors gave the order to his fellow disciples.
“Yes.”

The four of them replied, wheeled and walked into the dungeon. It was just that when they were entering the dungeon, they were shocked to find a pretty girl in blue robe appearing unnoticeably in their field of vision.
“Who are you?” one of them shouted.
All of them felt incredibly shocked. They weren’t idiots. The fact that she could come into the dungeon without arousing notice indicated that she was a very terrifying person.
Note:

The dozen men gave their own remarks.
They were crystal clear about the situation outside.
The yellow-robed youth had dealt a very strong blow to their hearts that they could hardly accept it.
Now, the only thing they could do was to keep a close eye at these girls while waiting for their Senior Brother Yan to kill the enemy.
If even Senior Brother Yan wasn’t a match for the enemy, these girls were going to be their last resort.
“The few of you go and watch after those girls.
Once the situation isn’t in our favour, immediately pull all the girls out,” one of the intermediate Immortal Emperors gave the order to his fellow disciples.
“Yes.”
The four of them replied, wheeled and walked into the dungeon.
It was just that when they were entering the dungeon, they were shocked to find a pretty girl in blue robe appearing unnoticeably in their field of vision.
“Who are you?” one of them shouted.
All of them felt incredibly shocked.
They weren’t idiots.
The fact that she could come into the dungeon without arousing notice indicated that she was a very terrifying person.

chapters.title: Chapter 1628 - The Annihilation of the City final
paragraphs: 6th of the week!
*Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!*
“Ah!” “Ah!” “Ah!” “Ah!”

Lan Lingji didn’t bother to talk with those people and waved out four blue rays of light, which pierced through the forehead of the four like a sword. They died on the spot even before they could put up any resistance. The final thing that they left behind before they passed away was their shrill screams.
“Saintess!”
“The saintess has come to saved us!”

The sudden appearance of Lan Lingji surprised the disciples of Exquisite Paradise. Their despairing faces were replaced by hope. After falling into the hands of the lewd men of All Pleasure Sect and being locked in the dungeon, there was nothing they could do besides sit in despair.
“Lan Lingji!”

The saintess of Celestial Flower Valley also showed a surprised look. The disciples of Celestial Flower Valley also began to react. After being imprisoned for so long in the cell, they could finally see the light at the end of the tunnel. The saintess of Celestial Flower Valley and Lan Lingji had maintained a good relationship. So in the disciples’ eyes, Lan Lingji was their ally.
“Who is it?”

A yell was heard. Those who were guarding the dungeon outside rushed into the dungeon at maximum speed. They then saw the four bodies lying on the ground with blood flowing out from their skull non-stop.

Lan Lingji moved again. A blue-light saint sword materialized in her hand before she thrust it to the disciples of the despicable sect. She didn’t waste even a second to speak with these people as though the act would only bring her disgrace.

The present situation was undoubtedly the best. As Dragon Shisan had already started his attack at the front line, it had drawn most of the disciples over there, leaving only a small number of guards behind at the dungeon which gave Lan Lingji the chance to sneak into it. Now that she had reached the cell of the girls, she would never let any of these lewd men to get near the female disciples.

Mournful cries began to ring from the dungeon. In just a few blinks, all the disciples of the obscene sect died a tragic death under Lan Lingji’s sword. The entire process was fast to the extreme. As the current Lan Lingji had already reached the late Immortal Emperor realm, these lewd disciples were like insects waiting to be killed.
“Saintess, you have advanced to late Immortal Emperor, amazing!”
The enhancement in Lan Lingji’s power excited every one of them. Everyone knew that Lan Lingji was the representative of Exquisite Paradise and her power represented the strength of her sect.
“Let me help you all to cure your poison first.”

Lan Lingji performed seals with her hands and struck out a large amount of pure energy. Everyone was enveloped by the energy. All of their qi began to change. In just about three breaths, the poison in their bodies was fully removed.

This type of poison was very easy to cure. One could directly eliminate it using immense energy. The reason these disciples were poisoned was because their cultivation base had been suppressed by Yan Yulong before they were forced to take the poisonous pill, allowing the poison to spread and take effect in their bodies, causing them to lose their combat strength. Which was why they were unable to remove the poison themselves.
Now that Lan Lingji was here and with her power, she had eliminated the poison inside of them with ease.
“Sister Lan, we of Celestial Flower Valley will never forget today’s kindness. We owe you a favour.”

The saintess of Celestial Flower Valley came to Lan Lingji’s front and bowed slightly. The fellow disciples of the saintess also did the same. As this was a life-saving grace, they couldn’t help feeling grateful to Lan Lingji.
“There’s no need to be polite. The people of All Pleasure Sect should be punished. All of them in this ancient city should die. None of them shall be left alive. But let’s leave this place first.”

Lan Lingji spoke coldly. The other girls revealed extreme disgust on their faces as soon as they heard the name of the sect. They absolutely wouldn’t be lenient when it came to killing the people of All Pleasure Sect.
“That Yan Yulong is tremendously powerful. Although Sister Lan has advanced to late Immortal Emperor realm, I’m afraid Sister Lan is still not a match for him.”
The saintess of Celestial Flower Valley spoke worriedly and couldn’t help gritting her teeth when mentioning Yan Yulong.
“Don’t worry. Currently, Yan Yulong can’t even ensure his own safety. Someone is getting rid of him outside.”

Lan Lingji smiled. Regarding the strength of Dragon Shisan, she had no doubt about it. No matter how powerful that Yan Yulong was, it was his bad luck to encounter Dragon Shisan. Dragon Shisan could kill him without any effort.

Outside the dungeon, Dragon Shisan’s momentum was overbearing. When Yan Yulong was about to attack, his face changed when he heard the miserable screams coming from the dungeon. Given his intelligence, he had already figured out what had happened. It seemed like this yellow-robed youngster had brought a helper.
“Let me handle him. You all will go into the dungeon and check what’s going on.”

Yan Yulong clamored at the remaining disciples who were extremely enraged at the moment. This ancient city was initially conquered by him and he was the absolute king of this city, but he had never thought that the tables would turn so quickly.
“Yes, Senior Brother Yan.”

Yan Yulong’s fellow disciples responded loudly and in harmony then headed towards the dungeon. They hadn’t bothered to think what was happening in the dungeon because obeying the order of Yan Yulong was always the top priority.

Incredible qi waves rushed out of the dungeon. With a blast, the palace above the dungeon collapsed in an instant. Powerful figures charged out from below and lunged at the disciples of All Pleasure Sect.
“Kill them all. No one shall be left alive.”

The saintess of Celestial Flower Valley went for the kill without another word. The other female disciples also launched their most powerful attack at the enemies. This time, Lan Lingji didn’t join the fight. She gave those who had been imprisoned the chance to vent their anger which was the best way to eradicate these lewd people.
Agonizing and earth-shattering cries came from the ancient city. Under the leadership of the saintess of Celestial Flower Valley, the female disciples attacked as fiercely and mercilessly as a tiger.

Yan Yulong turned his head and saw the tragic scene. His captives had already gotten out of the imprisonment. That was to say, all the disciples who guarded the dungeon were dead. Now, the remaining disciples were under the siege of the two forces of females, and it seemed like none of them would live either. Even including those who had been crippled by Dragon Shisan, All Pleasure Sect’s forces were left with only one general.
“Son of a b*tch!”

Yan Yulong bellowed, seemingly about to go mad. This was too hard to accept. He and his fellow disciples had obtained tremendous benefits when they first arrived at this ancient city, causing their cultivation base to improve by leaps and bounds and making them one of the strongest forces in Golden Horizon. It would be hard for any forces out there to handle them. Yan Yulong who enjoyed his position as the king didn’t think that the situation would change so quickly. In just a few blinks of time, all his brothers had been killed. Now, he was the only one left.

“Yan Yulong. Now it’s your turn, however Brother Shisan will give you a chance. As long as you get down on your knees and kowtow to Brother Shisan and use your own weapon to cut off the testicles in your crotch, I will consider letting you live and not crippling your cultivation base. What do you say? This is an opportunity of a lifetime. I hope you cherish it,” Dragon Shisan said.
“Courting death!”
Yan Yulong was already on the verge of going mad. Immediately, he unleashed all of his qi and anger. The folding fan was spread and thrust ferociously at Dragon Shisan.
“He is indeed stronger than the previous one.”

Sensing Yan Yulong’s powerful momentum, Dragon Shisan couldn’t help but nod. He couldn’t deny that this dude was much stronger compared to the other disciples and even Ye Peng, but this was only a comparison amongst the disciple’s peers. Yan Yulong’s strength wasn’t worth mentioning in front of Dragon Shisan.
*Bang!*

Treating the iron staff as a sword, he thrust it at the oncoming Yan Yulong. The top of the iron staff gave off a brilliant golden light that seemed able to pierce through everything. The qi waves struck out by the folding fan were shattered instantly.

The iron staff then hit the surface of the folding fan violently. Currently, the folding fan had already been turned into a clattering iron fan. The light emitted from the fan was even sharper than immortal weapons. It sliced the void into sections.

Nevertheless, the magnificent technique was no match for Dragon Shisan. Dragon Shisan was only given an iron staff ever since his birth. Up until now, he had yet to display any powerful combat technique. This absolutely wasn’t because he didn’t know any of them, but he had yet to meet an opponent worthy of his technique.
Once the innate ability of a Battle Saint Ape was displayed, it would definitely be an extremely terrifying scene. At least, this kind of terror was unbearable to normal people.

Yan Yulong was quickly rebounded by the impact and was sent a hundred meters away. The folding fan almost slipped off his hand. His expression changed dramatically as he looked at Dragon Shisan in disbelief.

Meanwhile, wails were heard incessantly on the other side. Anyone could see that the disciple of All Pleasure Sect was dying successively in the hands of the female disciples. The two groups of females were madly venting their anger on these lewd disciples.
“Did you see that? Your All Pleasure Sect is being annihilated.” Dragon Shisan chuckled.

Yan Yulong’s face darkened as he observed the surroundings. He knew that all of the disciples of his sect would die today. He then turned back to Dragon Shisan who was standing opposite of him. He also knew that he was no match for this enemy. For his life’s sake, he could only flee. As long as he survived today, there was still a chance for revenge in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 1629 - The Remains of A Great Sovereign
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
“Dragon Shisan, my sect is going to remember today’s incident. Sooner or later, we’ll settle this score with you.”

Yan Yulong left his last words whilst gritting his teeth, then tore apart the void and escaped into it. The losses today was too great to All Pleasure Sect. Most of the disciple who entered the Golden Horizon had stayed in this ancient city. By now, all of them had been killed. To put it bluntly, All Pleasure Sect suffered the greatest loss amongst the few hundred major powers. Majority of the disciples of other major powers had been separated into other parts of the Golden Horizon. All Pleasure Sect, however, had gathered together at once place, which was why they were so easily annihilated by the monkey.
“Wanting to run at this time? Don’t you think it’s a little late for that? If I let you run away now, where should I put my face at?”

Dragon Shisan’s qi fluctuated. How could he give Yan Yulong the chance to escape? Given his abilities, even if Yan Yulong had already fled ten thousand miles away from here, Yan Yulong wouldn’t be able to escape from his pursuit.
*Bang!*

The iron staff was hurled into the air. An immense energy instantly shattered the interior of the void. Yan Yulong, who had already fled into the void, was forced to reveal himself again as he had lost his direction inside.
“I’m going all out with you!”

Yan Yulong’s eyes went red as he roared. The folding fan in his hand suddenly enlarged into a forty-feet cattail leaf fan, blotting out the sky above him and pressed against at Dragon Shisan with immense energy. If one was smashed directly by it, one would instantly be crushed into pieces.
“Humph!”

Dragon Shisan harrumphed coldly. Sharp light shone from his eyes. The iron staff was once again raised high in his hand and slashed from above, immediately cutting the void in half. Then, it hit the iron fan of Yan Yulong like an indestructible sword with a boom.
*Hua La...*

Yan Yulong’s incredible energy was destroyed by this single blow. Infinite qi waves rolled and even the mighty iron fan couldn’t resist the blow. It was straightway smashed to pieces, leaving only the handle of the fan in Yan Yulong’s hand.
*Barf...*

Yan Yulong spurted out blood. He lowered his head to look at his own hand which was now covered in blood and had gone completely numb. The strike had not only shattered his immortal weapon, but also almost shattered his palm.
“Impossible. How can he be this strong?”

Yan Yulong shook his head constantly. He had never imagined this situation. There were plenty of abnormal beings in this world, but it was definitely his first time seeing an abnormal like Dragon Shisan. He had been very confident in his own cultivation base and combat strength. Being defeated by an intermediate Immortal Emperor genius was considered humiliating enough, but now, he couldn’t even flee for his life. Such a psychological blow was too great to bear.

Not far away, all the disciples of All Pleasure Sect had been fully eradicated by the female disciples. Then, seeing the battle scene between Dragon Shisan and Yan Yulong, the ladies’ mouths widened. Even the saintess of Celestial Flower Valley couldn’t believe the current scene. As she had been captured by Yan Yulong, she deeply understood the terror of the man. But now, a yellow-robed youth that came from nowhere had countered the attack of Yan Yulong despite being only an intermediate Immortal Emperor. If she wasn’t seeing this with her own eyes, she would never believe it.
“Sister Lan, who’s that man?”

The saintess of Celestial Flower Valley asked. She knew that this man must have come with Lan Lingji, who would not have been able to save them in the dungeon if the youth hadn’t been outside to handle the enemies.
“He’s Dragon Shisan. He saved my life before and is a rare genius,” said Lan Lingji proudly at the mention of Dragon Shisan’s name.
On the other side, Dragon Shisan looked contemptuously at Yan Yulong and said coldly, “So vulnerable.”
Dragon Shisan took one step after another towards Yan Yulong. His killing intent radiated from him openly.

Yan Yulong’s facial expression changed completely. He had been used to a life of freedom and had sex with countless women in his life and hadn’t had enough of it. His life had been full of excitement and passion. He didn’t want to die yet, but now, he was undoubtedly sensing the scent of death that was creeping closer and closer to him.
“Don’t kill me. You won’t gain anything by killing me. All Pleasure Sect will never let you go.” Yan Yulong spoke in a quavering voice.
“Don’t worry. When I have free time, I will head to Northern Profound Domain to annihilate your unnecessary sect for good.” Dragon Shisan spoke coldly and hit the head of Yan Yulong with a wave.
Yan Yulong died.

By now, all the people of All Pleasure Sect had been killed. No, there were still a few of them who hadn’t died yet, but they suffered a hundred times more compared to those who died. They were suffering the cruelest torture in the world. Not only had they lost their dignity, but also lost their most important thing and cultivation base. They didn’t even have the ability to heal themselves.

With their current condition, even if they were kept alive, they could live for only three days at best. Even if their tenacity help them survive more than three days, it was impossible for them to go anywhere in the Golden Horizon where dangers and killings happened almost everywhere. So there would be only one outcome for them - death. Any evil creature that spotted them would surely eat them.
Lan Lingji led the group to Dragon Shisan and said, “Brother Shisan, what should we do with those people below?”
“Let them run their own course.”
Dragon Shisan spoke plainly. He didn’t have the slightest sympathy towards those people. He wouldn’t even give them a swift death.
“They should all be tortured in such a way. All the people of All Pleasure Sect are abominable. Killing them is just letting them off too lightly.”
A female disciple of Exquisite Paradise spoke sternly. The fury in her eyes hadn’t vanished yet. The thought of the experiences they had in the ancient city made her grind her teeth in hatred.

“Alright. Let me introduce him to you all. He’s Dragon Shisan, the one who saved me when I was in a crisis, and also the reason why I’m able to stand here. After receiving your distress signal, he has come along with me to rescue you all.”

Lan Lingji recounted her encounters before turning to Dragon Shisan and added, “Brother Shisan, this is the saintess of Celestial Flower Valley, Hua Xiaoqian. The rest are the disciples of Exquisite Paradise and Celestial Flower Valley. Exquisite Paradise has always gotten along well with the Celestial Flower Valley, our master and the master of Celestial Flower Valley are also good friends.”

“Hua Xiaoqian thanks Young Master Dragon for rescuing us. Celestial Flower Valley will never forget your great kindness. From now on, Young Master Dragon will be the guest of honor of Celestial Flower Valley.”

Hua Xiaoqian slightly bowed to Dragon Shisan and expressed her gratitude. She knew very well that without Dragon Shisan, Lan Lingji wouldn’t be able to save them and would probably fall in the battlefield. Of course, since Lan Lingji had advanced to late Immortal Emperor realm, it wouldn’t be an easy task for Yan Yulong to slay her.
“Thank you Young Master Dragon for saving us.” The disciples of the two sects expressed their thanks in harmony.
*Cough...* *Cough...* *Cough...*
Dragon Shisan feigned to cough for three times. Facing so many pretty ladies, he began to feel somewhat shy. He slightly scratched his head and smiled awkwardly, not knowing what to say.
Damn! I’m the handsome and elegant Brother Shisan. How can I be shy in front of girls? How shameful! Dragon Shisan scolded himself.
“Brother Shisan, where are we heading now?”
Seeing the discomfort of Dragon Shisan, Lan Lingji hastily switched the topic to clear off the awkwardness.
“En, we will head towards the center of the Golden Horizon now and rendezvous with Little Chen,” said Dragon Shisan.
Regarding the suggestion of Dragon Shisan, none of them had any opinion as their destination was also the center of the Golden Horizon as well. So they might as well travel together.
Not long after Dragon Shisan and the group of girls left, the entire Golden Horizon suddenly shook violently.
*Hong Long Long...*

There was a roar that came from the Heavens and Earth. A tremor could be felt across the entire Golden Horizon. As long as one was in Golden Horizon, regardless of where the person was, he would be able to clearly feel the huge fluctuation. Dragon Shisan and the others’ facial expression changed slightly. They then saw a bright glow in the distant void. Clearly, that was where the great movement was coming from.
“What a powerful movement! What’s that over there? The light is getting stronger and stronger.” Hua Xiaoqian spoke with astonishment. Everyone’s gaze was fixed in the same direction.
“It has shaken the entire Golden Horizon with a casual movement. Could it be the birth of a Great Sovereign’s remains?”
Dragon Shisan was astounded. Immediately, he circulated the Fiery Golden Eyes but to his shock, he couldn’t see through it.

“Come on, let’s go. The movement this time is very big. I’m afraid that it’s going to alarm everyone. Little Chen will surely go there as well. It’s very likely that the inheritance of a Great Sovereign has emerged, or it may even be related to the secrets of the Golden Clan,” said Dragon Shisan. He then set off once again with the group of angels.

Meanwhile, Jiang Chen, Tyrant and Yang Bufan were also alarmed by the momentum. Yang Bufan had just fully recovered, and his cultivation base had stabilized at the peak of intermediate Immortal Emperor realm. He had regained his full strength.

“That’s a very powerful qi! It’s so much stronger compared to the emergence of the immortal vault of the ancient Buddha. It has shaken the whole Golden Horizon. It’s possibly the emergence of a Great Sovereign’s inheritance.”
Jiang Chen’s expression seemed slightly affected. With no neglect, they flew towards where the movement came from.

sentences.text: Extra dose of the week!
“Dragon Shisan, my sect is going to remember today’s incident.
Sooner or later, we’ll settle this score with you.”
Yan Yulong left his last words whilst gritting his teeth, then tore apart the void and escaped into it.
The losses today was too great to All Pleasure Sect.
Most of the disciple who entered the Golden Horizon had stayed in this ancient city.
By now, all of them had been killed.
To put it bluntly, All Pleasure Sect suffered the greatest loss amongst the few hundred major powers.
Majority of the disciples of other major powers had been separated into other parts of the Golden Horizon.
All Pleasure Sect, however, had gathered together at once place, which was why they were so easily annihilated by the monkey.
“Wanting to run at this time?
Don’t you think it’s a little late for that?
If I let you run away now, where should I put my face at?”
Dragon Shisan’s qi fluctuated.
How could he give Yan Yulong the chance to escape?
Given his abilities, even if Yan Yulong had already fled ten thousand miles away from here, Yan Yulong wouldn’t be able to escape from his pursuit.
*Bang!*
The iron staff was hurled into the air.
An immense energy instantly shattered the interior of the void.
Yan Yulong, who had already fled into the void, was forced to reveal himself again as he had lost his direction inside.
“I’m going all out with you!”
Yan Yulong’s eyes went red as he roared.
The folding fan in his hand suddenly enlarged into a forty-feet cattail leaf fan, blotting out the sky above him and pressed against at Dragon Shisan with immense energy.
If one was smashed directly by it, one would instantly be crushed into pieces.
“Humph!”
Dragon Shisan harrumphed coldly.
Sharp light shone from his eyes.
The iron staff was once again raised high in his hand and slashed from above, immediately cutting the void in half.
Then, it hit the iron fan of Yan Yulong like an indestructible sword with a boom.
*Hua La...*
Yan Yulong’s incredible energy was destroyed by this single blow.
Infinite qi waves rolled and even the mighty iron fan couldn’t resist the blow.
It was straightway smashed to pieces, leaving only the handle of the fan in Yan Yulong’s hand.
*Barf...*
Yan Yulong spurted out blood.
He lowered his head to look at his own hand which was now covered in blood and had gone completely numb.
The strike had not only shattered his immortal weapon, but also almost shattered his palm.
“Impossible.
How can he be this strong?”
Yan Yulong shook his head constantly.
He had never imagined this situation.
There were plenty of abnormal beings in this world, but it was definitely his first time seeing an abnormal like Dragon Shisan.
He had been very confident in his own cultivation base and combat strength.
Being defeated by an intermediate Immortal Emperor genius was considered humiliating enough, but now, he couldn’t even flee for his life.
Such a psychological blow was too great to bear.
Not far away, all the disciples of All Pleasure Sect had been fully eradicated by the female disciples.
Then, seeing the battle scene between Dragon Shisan and Yan Yulong, the ladies’ mouths widened.
Even the saintess of Celestial Flower Valley couldn’t believe the current scene.
As she had been captured by Yan Yulong, she deeply understood the terror of the man.
But now, a yellow-robed youth that came from nowhere had countered the attack of Yan Yulong despite being only an intermediate Immortal Emperor.
If she wasn’t seeing this with her own eyes, she would never believe it.
“Sister Lan, who’s that man?”
The saintess of Celestial Flower Valley asked.
She knew that this man must have come with Lan Lingji, who would not have been able to save them in the dungeon if the youth hadn’t been outside to handle the enemies.
“He’s Dragon Shisan.
He saved my life before and is a rare genius,” said Lan Lingji proudly at the mention of Dragon Shisan’s name.
On the other side, Dragon Shisan looked contemptuously at Yan Yulong and said coldly, “So vulnerable.”
Dragon Shisan took one step after another towards Yan Yulong.
His killing intent radiated from him openly.
Yan Yulong’s facial expression changed completely.
He had been used to a life of freedom and had sex with countless women in his life and hadn’t had enough of it.
His life had been full of excitement and passion.
He didn’t want to die yet, but now, he was undoubtedly sensing the scent of death that was creeping closer and closer to him.
“Don’t kill me.
You won’t gain anything by killing me.
All Pleasure Sect will never let you go.” Yan Yulong spoke in a quavering voice.
“Don’t worry.
When I have free time, I will head to Northern Profound Domain to annihilate your unnecessary sect for good.” Dragon Shisan spoke coldly and hit the head of Yan Yulong with a wave.
Yan Yulong died.
By now, all the people of All Pleasure Sect had been killed.
No, there were still a few of them who hadn’t died yet, but they suffered a hundred times more compared to those who died.
They were suffering the cruelest torture in the world.
Not only had they lost their dignity, but also lost their most important thing and cultivation base.
They didn’t even have the ability to heal themselves.
With their current condition, even if they were kept alive, they could live for only three days at best.
Even if their tenacity help them survive more than three days, it was impossible for them to go anywhere in the Golden Horizon where dangers and killings happened almost everywhere.
So there would be only one outcome for them - death.
Any evil creature that spotted them would surely eat them.
Lan Lingji led the group to Dragon Shisan and said, “Brother Shisan, what should we do with those people below?”
“Let them run their own course.”
Dragon Shisan spoke plainly.
He didn’t have the slightest sympathy towards those people.
He wouldn’t even give them a swift death.
“They should all be tortured in such a way.
All the people of All Pleasure Sect are abominable.
Killing them is just letting them off too lightly.”
A female disciple of Exquisite Paradise spoke sternly.
The fury in her eyes hadn’t vanished yet.
The thought of the experiences they had in the ancient city made her grind her teeth in hatred.
“Alright.
Let me introduce him to you all.
He’s Dragon Shisan, the one who saved me when I was in a crisis, and also the reason why I’m able to stand here.
After receiving your distress signal, he has come along with me to rescue you all.”
Lan Lingji recounted her encounters before turning to Dragon Shisan and added, “Brother Shisan, this is the saintess of Celestial Flower Valley, Hua Xiaoqian.
The rest are the disciples of Exquisite Paradise and Celestial Flower Valley.
Exquisite Paradise has always gotten along well with the Celestial Flower Valley, our master and the master of Celestial Flower Valley are also good friends.”
“Hua Xiaoqian thanks Young Master Dragon for rescuing us.
Celestial Flower Valley will never forget your great kindness.
From now on, Young Master Dragon will be the guest of honor of Celestial Flower Valley.”
Hua Xiaoqian slightly bowed to Dragon Shisan and expressed her gratitude.
She knew very well that without Dragon Shisan, Lan Lingji wouldn’t be able to save them and would probably fall in the battlefield.
Of course, since Lan Lingji had advanced to late Immortal Emperor realm, it wouldn’t be an easy task for Yan Yulong to slay her.
“Thank you Young Master Dragon for saving us.” The disciples of the two sects expressed their thanks in harmony.
*Cough...* *Cough...* *Cough...*
Dragon Shisan feigned to cough for three times.
Facing so many pretty ladies, he began to feel somewhat shy.
He slightly scratched his head and smiled awkwardly, not knowing what to say.
Damn!
I’m the handsome and elegant Brother Shisan.
How can I be shy in front of girls?
How shameful!
Dragon Shisan scolded himself.
“Brother Shisan, where are we heading now?”
Seeing the discomfort of Dragon Shisan, Lan Lingji hastily switched the topic to clear off the awkwardness.
“En, we will head towards the center of the Golden Horizon now and rendezvous with Little Chen,” said Dragon Shisan.
Regarding the suggestion of Dragon Shisan, none of them had any opinion as their destination was also the center of the Golden Horizon as well.
So they might as well travel together.
Not long after Dragon Shisan and the group of girls left, the entire Golden Horizon suddenly shook violently.
*Hong Long Long...*
There was a roar that came from the Heavens and Earth.
A tremor could be felt across the entire Golden Horizon.
As long as one was in Golden Horizon, regardless of where the person was, he would be able to clearly feel the huge fluctuation.
Dragon Shisan and the others’ facial expression changed slightly.
They then saw a bright glow in the distant void.
Clearly, that was where the great movement was coming from.
“What a powerful movement!
What’s that over there?
The light is getting stronger and stronger.” Hua Xiaoqian spoke with astonishment.
Everyone’s gaze was fixed in the same direction.
“It has shaken the entire Golden Horizon with a casual movement.
Could it be the birth of a Great Sovereign’s remains?”
Dragon Shisan was astounded.
Immediately, he circulated the Fiery Golden Eyes but to his shock, he couldn’t see through it.
“Come on, let’s go.
The movement this time is very big.
I’m afraid that it’s going to alarm everyone.
Little Chen will surely go there as well.
It’s very likely that the inheritance of a Great Sovereign has emerged, or it may even be related to the secrets of the Golden Clan,” said Dragon Shisan.
He then set off once again with the group of angels.
Meanwhile, Jiang Chen, Tyrant and Yang Bufan were also alarmed by the momentum.
Yang Bufan had just fully recovered, and his cultivation base had stabilized at the peak of intermediate Immortal Emperor realm.
He had regained his full strength.
“That’s a very powerful qi!
It’s so much stronger compared to the emergence of the immortal vault of the ancient Buddha.
It has shaken the whole Golden Horizon.
It’s possibly the emergence of a Great Sovereign’s inheritance.”
Jiang Chen’s expression seemed slightly affected.
With no neglect, they flew towards where the movement came from.

chapters.title: Chapter 1630 - Brothers Reunion
paragraphs: 7th of the week!

At this moment, all the people in Golden Horizon were alerted. Regardless of where they were, the tremendous movement had attracted their attention. The brilliant light spread to millions of miles. Wherever they might be, they were surely able to sense such a big movement.

That was to say, seeing the light at a close distance or from millions of miles away made no difference. It was like a kind of illusion that resembled the scorching sun in the sky. No matter where they are, they would see the same thing and as clear as the others, which made this an undoubtedly mystical scene.
“It has to be the remains of a Great Sovereign. It has to be it! Otherwise, it wouldn’t create such massive energy waves. It has shaken the entire Golden Horizon. I wonder what has actually emerged.”

“Let’s go and see. It seems like it’s situated at the centremost of the Golden Horizon. Legends says that there was once a Great Sovereign that died there. I initially thought that it was fake, but it seems like my inference was wrong.”

“That is also where the bloodline of the Golden Clan fell. I heard that this clan was once a very powerful major power and had more than one Great Sovereign. So, it’s not surprising at all for an inheritance of a Great Sovereign to exist there. I speculate that this has to be related to the Golden Clan. Perhaps, this inheritance belonged to a Great Sovereign of that clan.”

No one wasn’t shocked. The Golden Horizon had existed for tens of thousands of years, but the remains of the Great Sovereigns had never revealed itself which made people think that it was just a legend. After all, Great Sovereigns were very powerful and invincible. It was the highest realm of Immortals and almost comparable to gods. So how could they possibly fall?

There was another rumour about the Golden Horizon - the Golden Clan. They were the descendants of the Divine Bird Golden Crow and possesses the bloodline of the Divine Bird. There had been more than one Great Sovereign born in that clan. As such, some of them still believed the legend about the fall of the Great Sovereign.
Currently, an inheritance of some Great Sovereign had finally appeared. All the geniuses felt compelled to find out more about it.
*Hong Long...*

The tremor in the Golden Horizon was getting stronger. The earth, space, void and mountains, all of these things were trembling. The whole world seemed to be quaking. A heavy cloud of pressure hovered in the sky above the Golden Horizon, making people feel oppressed.

At the centre of the barren mountain range, a low mountain broke into pieces. A vigorous and strong figure flew out from it. His body was full of strong divine light. He wore a golden robe. His blond hair fluttered in the wind. He lifted his head to look at the place where the inheritance had appeared, divine light cast out from his eyes.
“The Eye of Heaven has finally recovered. Jiang Chen and that damned monkey! It’s time for them to die. After obtaining the legacy of the Great Sovereign, I will kill the both of them.”

Incredible qi was radiating from the man’s body, making him overbearing to the extreme. This blond male was none other Nan Beichao who had been in seclusion the whole time. The current Nan Beichao had grown many times stronger compared to when he was defeated by the monkey. A huge transformation had taken place inside of him. His cultivation base had now reached the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, a grade higher than before, plus his Eye of Heaven had been fully restored.

One had to admit that Nanbei Chao was exceedingly powerful. He had only used a mere few days to heal the Eye of Heaven and advance one realm. Apart from Jiang Chen, no one else in the Immortal World could possibly have such a rapid progress like Nanbei Chao.

Furthermore, Nanbei Chao was powerful enough to defeat the late Immortal Emperor Mo Wuqing when he was merely an early Immortal Emperor. Now that he had advanced to the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, it was hard to imagine how powerful he was now.
With a step, he vanished in a stream of light, shooting towards where the remains of Great Sovereign.

Meanwhile, experts from different major powers were also flying towards the same direction. Just as Jiang Chen expected, the current Golden Horizon was no longer the same back then. Many geniuses had acquired great benefits that enhanced their cultivation base by leaps and bounds. Numerous intermediate Immortal Emperors had advanced to late Immortal Emperor realm. Each of them was stronger than the other. There were even some mysterious places where the qi of a half-step Immortal Venerable was detected.
*Swoosh...* *Swoosh...* *Swoosh...*

Countless silhouettes were flying towards the remains of the Great Sovereign as it was just too attractive. If this happened in the outside world, it was afraid that it would shake all the people in the whole Immortal Domain.

Very quickly, Jiang Chen and his comrades arrived a few hundred miles away from their destination. As the destination was under massive pressure, they didn’t dare to approach it until the inheritance fully emerged. Or else, they might not be able to withstand the pressure.

People were appearing very quickly. In just a matter of a few blinks, at least five or six thousand people had arrived at the same place as Jiang Chen. There were still bulks of people coming towards the same direction. To put it bluntly, the great inheritance had gathered innumerable geniuses together, making it a true grand meeting.
“Little Chen.”
Just as Jiang Chen, Tyrant and Yang Bufan arrived, two silhouettes appeared next to them. They were Big Yellow and Wu Ningzhu.
“Big Yellow, Sister Ning!”

Jiang Chen and Tyrant exclaimed. Their faces showed crazy excitement. They had been separated ever since Jiang Chen had been hunted down by Nan Beichao. Delight overflowed their faces when they saw that each one of them was still intact, especially Big Yellow and Wu Ningzhu who had been worrying so much about Jiang Chen’s safety.
“Haha! I knew it, that Nanbei Chao wouldn’t be able to kill you.”

Big Yellow laughed loudly. He and Wu Ningzhu had been searching for treasures and Jiang Chen this whole time. Due to the direction they went being opposite of Jiang Chen’s, they hadn’t met each other until now.
Wu Ningzhu lost control of her excitement and leaped into Jiang Chen’s arms.
“It’s good that you are alright,” Wu Ningzhu spoke plainly. She could let go of the weight in her heart at last.
“How could I be not alright? Sister Ning, you have progressed a lot, reaching the half-step Immortal Emperor realm.”

Jiang Chen said with a smile, naturally feeling delighted when he saw the cultivation realm of Wu Ningzhu. It was without a doubt, the right choice to bring Wu Ningzhu in this expedition. If Wu Ningzhu continued to stay in King Fan Prefecture, it would be extremely difficult for her to make any progress.
And the real surprise was Big Yellow whose cultivation base had already reached the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm.
“Big Yellow, have you also eaten some bloody good sh*t? How did you progress so quickly?” Jiang Chen stretched out his hand to touch Big Yellow’s head.
Big Yellow gritted his teeth. “Scram! It wasn’t sh*t! You should know that Master Dog is number one in seeking treasures!”

Big Yellow showed a proud look. Regarding this, Jiang Chen was very impressed. It seemed like it was the wisest decision to leave Wu Ningzhu with Big Yellow, because anyone who followed Big Yellow would never be short of treasures. The nostril of this dog was unordinary. Therefore, Jiang Chen didn’t feel very strange about the progress of the two. After all, this was the Golden Horizon. Numerous treasures could possibly be found here.
“Tyrant, I never thought of meeting you here, and Little King Fan. Master Dog does feel pretty delighted seeing the progress of you two.”
Big Yellow spoke solemnly as though he was talking to his promising juniors, making the others roll their eyes frenziedly. However, the reunion was definitely a delightful thing.
“Little Chen, I have come!”

At this moment, a yell was heard. Dragon Shisan quickly rushed towards Jiang Chen’s side as soon as he spotted him. Coming along with him was Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian and two groups of female disciples from two major powers. Instantly, the scene turned lively.
“It seems like you two have managed to save all the people.”
Upon seeing Dragon Shisan, Jiang Chen smiled. He knew that there was nothing Dragon Shisan couldn’t handle.
“That’s of course. I have also eradicated a rubbish major power.”
Dragon Shisan spoke. When he turned to Big Yellow, he went to tug Big Yellow’s ear without saying a word.
*Bark...*
Big Yellow too bit Dragon Shisan’s hand without warning. Despite the fast reaction of Dragon Shisan, a few teeth marks were still left on his hand.
“Dammit! Why are you biting so violently?”
Dragon Shisan was rendered speechless. This dog’s reaction was so quick he didn’t have time to react.
“For Heaven’s Sake! Who the hell are you? If Master Dog wasn’t lenient to you, your hand would have been torn off by me. How dare you pull my ear?! Courting death!”

Big Yellow gnashed his teeth and spoke violently to Dragon Shisan. There were only a few people in this world that could touch his ear. Today, a stranger that came from nowhere had tugged his ear for no reason. How could he ever accept that? If he didn’t see that Jiang Chen and the stranger knew each other, he surely wouldn’t show any mercy to the stranger.
Jiang Chen rolled his eyes. He knew that these two bastards were going to create such a scene as soon as they met.

“Big Yellow, do you still remember that wondrous rock? He’s called Dragon Shisan. He was the one that leaped out of that rock. He’s an immemorial battle spirit, a Battle Saint Ape. If it hadn’t been for him, I would have been killed by Nan Beichao.”

Jiang Chen hastily made the introduction. As for Big Yellow and the others, he didn’t need to introduce them to Dragon Shisan, because he already knew them while he was still in the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda.
“Sh*t! It turns out that it was a monkey that leaped out from the rock. And it is a Battle Saint Ape. Bloody hell, your bloodline is even greater than Master Dog.”

Big Yellow widened his eyes. This was something that he hadn’t thought of. However, when he saw that mystical rock back then, he knew that the living creature inside was extraordinary. He had never thought that Dragon Shisan would be born so quickly, however. At least, it was a lot faster than his imagination.

chapters.title: Chapter 1631 - Overflowing with Geniuses
paragraphs: 8th of the week!

Of course, Big Yellow was also a pretty abnormal being. Being an unusual kind of Dragon-Horse, no one could measure his potential. Plus, there was a tremendous secret hidden inside of him. No one knew about it, not even Jiang Chen.
“That’s right, Big Yellow. You can call me Brother Shisan from now on.” Dragon Shisan chuckled at Big Yellow.
“Scram! You stupid monkey.”
Unexpectedly, Big Yellow didn’t give Dragon Shisan any face, turning the monkey’s face dark instantly. “You bloody dog! Can’t you at least give me face in front of these pretty ladies?!”
“Get lost, you stupid monkey! Don’t talk about face before Master Dog.”
Big Yellow shook his head persistently, giving Dragon Shisan the impulse to beat him up, but was stopped by Jiang Chen in time. “It’s enough, you two. Please be mindful of your current situation.”

The scene gave Jiang Chen some slight headache. Although the both of them were bound to have quarrels again in the future, but the present situation was absolutely not suitable for their argument. The remains of the Great Sovereign was going to emerge soon. It was better for them not to draw any attention.

It was Yang Bufan’s first time hearing about the wondrous rock, but after the introduction of Jiang Chen, they knew each other now. After all, they were on the same side. Furthermore, Yang Bufan wasn’t idiotic. He naturally knew the scariness of the Battle Saint Ape and wouldn’t dare to show any neglect towards the monkey.

After the introduction of Dragon Shisan, everyone got to know Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian and the other girls, and was able to click with one another. Lan Lingji and Hua Xiaoqian were both unparalleled beauties. They normally wouldn’t dart a glance to ordinary geniuses, much less getting in touch with them, but regarding Jiang Chen’s group of geniuses, they didn’t seem to refuse their company.

Of course, the major reason was that Dragon Shisan had saved their lives. They had regarded Dragon Shisan as their saviour. So naturally, they would regard the friends of Dragon Shisan as their allies. And because of Yang Bufan, a friendlier relationship was formed between Great Qian Empire, Exquisite Paradise and Celestial Flower Valley.

The eleven major powers of Eastern Profound Domain had been competing continuously with one another. Most of them didn’t get along well. It was rare for any major power to befriend the other. If Great Qian Empire could ally itself with Exquisite Paradise and Celestial Flower Valley, it would undoubtedly be a good thing to the three major powers.
*Swoosh...* *Swoosh...* *Swoosh...*

Powerful figures continued to emerge. In a short while, the total number of geniuses had reached approximately 10 000. The cultivation base of the geniuses had obviously improved by a lot as compared to the beginning. The number of late Immortal Emperors were still increasing.

“It seems like the Golden Horizon is really a good place. How long has it been since we have arrived? The progress everyone made was incredible, totally incomparable to the time when we just entered here,” Hua Xiaoqian sighed.

“That’s of course. There are opportunities everywhere in Golden Horizon. As long as one doesn’t die, one will be able to obtain benefits. Additionally, most of the geniuses that came in here have overflowing talent. And many are equipped with great luck. So the longer they stay in this place, the higher the chances for them to advance. More and more expert will be produced. Even half-step Immortal Venerables will emerge in the end,” said Yang Bufan. His eyes sparkled, full of anticipation about the Golden Horizon.

“Look, that’s Zhang Yulang from the Immortal Court of Ethereal Immortal Domain. I heard that he’s very terrifying - his body contained the bloodline of an ancient living creature, although I have no idea if that’s true. His current cultivation base has already reached the peak of late Immortal Emperor realm, only a step away from the half-step Immortal Venerable realm.”

“Look at that person. He’s Xia Xiaotian from the Immortal Court of Radiance Immortal Domain. It’s rumoured that the bloodline of a Great Sovereign is flowing inside his body. His current cultivation base is also at the peak of late Immortal Emperor realm. I’m afraid that it will only take him less than a few days to advance to the half-step Immortal Venerable realm.”

“This time, too many geniuses have entered. In addition to the extraordinary geniuses of Immortal Court, there is also Nanbei Chao of Nanbei Family who was called the reincarnation of a Great Sovereign, an extremely terrifying man.”

As powerful geniuses were popping up non-stop, the faces of the others changed. There were too many great talents. Each of them was full of luck. Most of them had incredible bloodline flowing in their bodies. If the situation continued to develop in such a way, the moment this expedition ends, most of them would become half-step Immortal Venerable geniuses. The thought of this was rather terrifying.

Jiang Chen and his comrades were seeing the continuous flow of experts too. Even with their pride, they had to admit the scariness of these geniuses. The geniuses from Immortal Court, in particular, had unusual bloodline and incredible methods. Take Xia Xiaotian and Zhang Yulang for example, although they were late Immortal Emperors, Ye Peng was absolutely at a different level compared to them. Dragon Shisan could beat Ye Peng to death, but it was still unknown if he could defeat geniuses of such caliber. Most of them inherited the ancient legacy of their family, so no one knew how powerful they really were.
“It seems like this place isn’t going to be desolate anymore.”

Jiang Chen’s fighting spirit was completely ignited. This was a generation that was overflowing with geniuses. Anyone that live in this generation wouldn’t be bored; Jiang Chen didn’t like mediocrity and plain life. He needed passion, and his dragon transformation skill needed constant improvement.
Just at this time, murderous eyes were looking at them. The killing intent was incomparably great, proud and high and mighty. It had straightaway enveloped them.
Jiang Chen and his comrades sensed it, and quickly turned over and saw Nanbei Chao staring at them from a distance.
“It’s Nanbei Chao again.” Wu Ningzhu’s facial expression changed slightly.
“This a**h*le progresses pretty quickly. He has already reached the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm.” Big Yellow couldn’t help but swear.
“He’s a tough one,” Tyrant spoke.

They were the ones who had fought Nanbei Chao before, so they knew the power of this person. Back in Saint Origin World, Nanbei Chao tried to conquer the world using his clone. Therefore, it was hard to tell how terrifyingly powerful his true self would be.
“It seems like Nanbei Chao of Nanbei Family is truly the reincarnation of a Great Sovereign.”
Hua Xiaoqian sighed. As a genius of Eastern Profound Domain, and born in the same generation as Nanbei Chao, she felt utterly pressured.
“Just a loser. Even if he has advanced to the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, Brother Shisan isn’t afraid of him.”
Dragon Shisan met Nanbei Chao’s eyes, unleashed his qi of Battle Saint Ape and showed no sign of fear towards Nanbei Chao.
“It seems like more have joined the group. Do you all want to die along with Jiang Chen?” Nanbei Chao said.
He had always been arrogant and tyrannical and did not put others in his eyes. Even if the Lord of the Heavens was here, he still wouldn’t hesitate to kill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1632 - The power of Nanbei Chao
paragraphs: 1st of the week!

Nanbei Chao’s remark almost distorted the nostrils of the group. Big Yellow was the first who snapped and immediately retorted, “Nanbei Chao, can you put away your mothering look? It agitates Master Dog so much. Why don’t you reflect on your own abilities first before coming here to kill people!”
“Humph! How dare this dog speak so arrogantly in front of me! Courting death.”

Nanbei Chao harrumphed coldly. Without another word, he struck out a humongous palm at Big Yellow. This had been Nanbei Chao’s style. In his eyes, he was the Monarch, the king of Heavens and Earth, and a supreme and noble being. Everyone was just insects in his eyes. Whoever dared to disrespect him should be eliminated at once.
“Dammit! Master Dog isn’t afraid of you!”

Big Yellow, too, was a hot-tempered one. He surely wouldn’t accept how Nanbei Chao treated him. In a flash, his sturdy body grew by twofold. The top of his head was glittering with golden light. The surface of his body was being covered with dragon scales.
Then, he turned into a ray of golden light and charged into the palm condensed by Nanbei Chao.
*Bang!*

A huge crater was immediately created in the void. The attack launched by Nanbei Chao was smashed to pieces by Big Yellow. But Big Yellow was not in a favorable situation either. His huge body was rebounded by the impact, afflicting him with vertigo.
“The f! This son of a b*tch is undeniably powerful.”

Big Yellow exclaimed secretly, however, he didn’t know that his performance had brought astonishment to everyone. Numerous people were gaping at the scene. Even Nanbei Chao himself couldn’t help but be astounded.
“It seems like you do have some skills. Since your head is that hard, I will break it for good.”
Nanbei Chao launched a similar palm strike at Big Yellow. But its destructive force was two times stronger than before, very terrifying.
“Son of a b*tch! It’s a pity that Master Dog’s hidden power couldn’t be fully unleashed yet. Otherwise, it won’t be a problem for me to defeat you.”
Big Yellow gritted his teeth, feeling incomparably stifled at the thought of his current situation.
*Bang!*

At this time, an iron staff rushed out from one side, striking heavily at the enormous palm of Nanbei Chao. The huge palm shattered with a clatter. The strike precisely came from Dragon Shisan. Even in Jiang Chen’s group, it was afraid that only Dragon Shisan could deal with Nanbei Chao for now.
“Look, a fight has broken out in that direction. It seems like an intense fight.”

“That’s Nanbei Chao. He’s a very terrifying expert. Back in the Broken Edge Cliff, he killed plenty of experts, even Mo Wuqing was no match for him. I had never thought that he would advance to intermediate Immortal Emperor, which will make his combat strength even greater. Who’s the one fighting him? He’s also an intermediate Immortal Emperor, but he’s able to stay undefeated before Nanbei Chao.”
“They must have some scores to settle, otherwise Nanbei Chao wouldn’t attack them at this critical moment when the inheritance of the Great Sovereign is about to emerge.”

The powerful shockwaves had attracted numerous people. Each of their eyes turned towards the same direction. Since the opening of the vault of the Great Sovereign would require some time, it would be good if they could watch some show, and witness the supreme methods of the true geniuses.
Nanbei Chao was packed with murderous intent and mercilessness.
“Jiang Chen, damned monkey! If you two immediately kneel and kowtow before me, I will consider giving you all a swift death!”
Nanbei Chao spoke with unprecedented arrogance. Yang Bufan and the girls almost coughed up blood as this was their first time seeing such an arrogant person.
“Nanbei Chao, you don’t have to be so arrogant. I will kill you sooner or later. I was able to kill both of your clones, I could also do it to you.”
Jiang Chen looked at Nanbei Chao and spoke composedly. Nanbei Chao’s overbearing power didn’t affect Jiang Chen in the slightest. In front of Nanbei Chao, Jiang Chen’s qi had never once faltered.

“Loser, what are you being so arrogant for? You thought that you can kill us all just because you have advanced to intermediate Immortal Emperor? How amusing!” Dragon Shisan sneered, his body was full of combat intent.
“Yes, monkey, I’m going to settle my score with you two.”

Nanbei Chao’s blond hair fluttered in the air. Without a second word, he launched a punch. He must kill Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan today. Needless to say that Jiang Chen was his fated enemy; and, Dragon Shisan had once destroyed his Eye of Heaven which brought great harm to him and causing him to lose the chance of killing Jiang Chen. This made Nanbei Chao hate Dragon Shisan to the very core. He also had the impulse to rush forward and rip the monkey apart.
*Hong Long...*
The void was instantly blasted apart. The Wisdom King Fist of Nanbei Chao was extremely terrifying. It sealed the surrounding area and appeared in front of Dragon Shisan in the blink of an eye.
“It comes at the right time.”
Dragon Shisan’s eyes sparkled ten thousand brilliance. The iron staff in his hand elongated to a hundred meters, and was smashed at the Wisdom King Fist.
Terrifying qi waves rolled. If both of them hadn’t opened a new battlefield, only God knows how heavy the casualties would be.

The Wisdom King Fist was destroyed by the iron staff, but Dragon Shisan was forced back by two steps. The iron staff held in his hand let out a buzzing sound. It only showed that Dragon Shisan had also suffered a great shock from this collision.
“Monkey, you are no longer a match for me. I haven’t even used my powerful techniques yet, and you only have an iron staff. Killing you is effortless.”
Nanbei Chao had gained the upper hand with this blow, which enormously increased his self-confidence.
“Is that so?”

Dragon Shisan’s face suddenly turned solemn. His arm shook and the iron staff was withdrawn. Both of his hands formed seals. An immemorial qi suddenly emerged. Nanbei Chao’s expression turned grim as he knew that this monkey definitely wasn’t as simple as the iron staff.

“This monkey is truly a powerful one. It seems like he’s going to use a mighty ancient combat technique. How terrifying! Perhaps he can really fight Nanbei Chao,” said Big Yellow. Before the battle, he wouldn’t have thought that Dragon Shisan would be this powerful.
“Honestly, this is my first time seeing him display a combat technique.”
Jiang Chen was full of curiosity. Previously, Dragon Shisan had only depended on the iron staff and had yet to use any techniques.
*Hong Long...*

Suddenly, the sky shook once more. A crack appeared in the sky. Great changes were taking place in the remains of the Great Sovereign. The two combatants who were in the middle of a fight couldn’t help but shift their eyes to it.

“The remains of the Great Sovereign is about to emerge. Damned monkey! I will let you go for now. After I obtain the inheritance, I will come to eradicate you and Jiang Chen. None of you can escape from me. All of you will have to die,” Nanbei Chao kept his qi and spoke.

In his opinion, it was only a matter of time before Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan died in his hands. Now that changes had occurred in the remains of the Great Sovereign, he had to preserve his strength to cope with anything that would happen inside. Furthermore, his true objective in coming to Golden Horizon was to obtain all the treasures in the remains of the Great Sovereign.

“Whenever you want!”
Dragon Shisan kept his qi, too. As a mighty Battle Saint Ape, he would never reject anyone’s threat, but even he had to admit that Nanbei Chao was an extremely powerful opponent.

Sudden changes happened abruptly in the middle of the life-and-death battle. But since the grudge had already been established, it was only a matter of time before the winner amongst them would be decided.

Innumerable eyes looked up and saw a huge opening appearing in the sky right above the remains of the Great Sovereign was located. It was like a heavenly river, boundless dazzling light was emitted from it.

“The vault of the remains of the Great Sovereign is about to be opened. Rush, everybody!” Someone yelled. Overwhelmed by the excitement in his heart, he shot towards the opening in a ray of light, but what happened next shocked countless people.

As soon as he touched the opening in the void, his body was instantly turned into a lump of meat paste and evaporated. Despite the fact that the man was an intermediate Immortal Emperor, he could only let out a wail in the face of the divine mouth.

However, this was also logical. After all, a puny intermediate Immortal Emperor was just like an ant to a great Immortal Sovereign. In fact, even a powerful Immortal Venerable expert stood no chance in front of a Great Sovereign.
“Not good! Don’t panic everyone. This isn’t the entrance to the vault of the Great Sovereign. Don’t get close to it.”

Someone cried out in alarm. Many geniuses who were already halfway hastily turned around and returned to where they were. Each of their foreheads was beaded with sweat as though they had just experienced a life-and-death crisis. They felt fortunate that they were a little slower. If they were a little faster, the consequences would be unimaginable - probably not even a piece of their remains would be left.
“What’s going on? Could it be that it isn’t the entrance to the vault? The remains of the Great Sovereign has been unearthed but why isn’t it letting anyone in? Why did it appear to begin with?”
“That’s true. The remains that have existed for ten thousand years suddenly emerged, but we aren’t allowed to enter into the vault. What’s the purpose of it?”

“That’s a very terrifying destructive energy. No one will be able to resist it. Even the strongest one in our group will certainly die if he intrudes into it. In that case, I might as well let go of this inheritance because my life is more important than any treasures.”

Innumerable remarks and sighs resounded across the air. All of them came here with the expectation that they could get even just a bit of the inheritance of the Great Sovereign. Now, it seemed like it wasn’t as simple. They couldn’t even enter the door of the vault, let alone finding benefits and treasures inside. It was only their wishful thinking.
“Big Yellow, can you tell what’s going on?” Jiang Chen looked over at Big Yellow.

“That isn’t the entrance at all. That’s a powerful killing intent unleashed from an unparalleled Sovereign Weapon. It’s combined with tens of thousands of years of killing intent. I’m afraid that even a powerful Immortal Venerable will die in that light. Those idiotic bastards know nothing about it and are only asking for trouble,” answered Big Yellow.
“What? You said that an unparalleled Sovereign Weapon is going to be born?”

Yang Bufan asked with astonishment. Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian and the other females were also staring at Big Yellow. Although it was their first time seeing Big Yellow, they didn’t have the slightest intention of looking down on him. The previous exchange of blows he had with Nanbei Chao was already sufficient to display his own strength. All of them knew that none of the people here was weak. Although Jiang Chen had the lowest cultivation base—late Immortal King realm—he was the least person they should underestimate as they had all heard about Jiang Chen’s name back in Eastern Profound Domain. Also, the fact that Nanbei Chao attached so much importance to Jiang Chen indicated that this youth with low cultivation base wasn’t as simple as he looked.
“That’s right. An unparalleled Sovereign Weapon is about to emerge.” Big Yellow nodded.

“Amazing! Everybody, be ready to seize it. If one of us is able to wield a Sovereign Weapon, that person will surely be able to go unhindered around the whole world.” A light of excitement glinted from Dragon Shisan’s eyes.

“Don’t get excited too early. It isn’t that simple to obtain a Sovereign Weapon. Each Sovereign Weapon has its own spirituality. They will find their own master. Even if one obtained it, one may not be able to wield it until one gets the recognition of the weapon. In addition, this type of weapon has been hidden for tens of thousands of years, and radiates dense killing intent. It will be hard for people to get near it. So everybody, hold your position. We’ll see what the weapon is first.”
Big Yellow warned the others. He seemed to know everything. He remained as composed even at the mention of a Sovereign Weapon.

The eyes of the people fell upon the newly-emerged Sovereign Weapon. However, something changed in Wu Ningzhu. Although her eyes were also fixed on the crack in the void, her expression was blank and her body shivered slightly, as though she had been summoned by some kind of tremendous force.

The warning taken from the previous cultivator made no one dare to act. Even a genius like Xia Xiaotian wouldn’t dare to joke around with his life. Although he was frenziedly proud, he wouldn’t reach the point where he would compete against a Great Sovereign.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

Suddenly, billions of light rushed out from it, enveloping the entire sky above. Then, an ancient Qin* exited the opening. Infinite pressure was unleashed the instant the ancient Qin emerged, as if a Great Sovereign was descending from above, looking down on everyone, making people not dare to look at it directly.
Dazzling golden light radiated out from the ancient qin. There was also the red-gold flames that flashed continuously like the fire of life.
“Xiao Yao Qin. It’s the Natal Sovereign Weapon of Emperor Xiao Yao Qin!”
Big Yellow was surprised when he saw the Qin. He was able to tell the name of the ancient Qin at first glance.
“The legendary Xiao Yao Qin has disappeared for too long. I had never thought his weapon will show up here.”

Yang Bufan stared absent-mindedly at the Qin and spoke. He had heard the legends about the Xiao Yao Qin. Most of them were no stranger to this. Emperor Xiao Yao Qin was a peerless Sovereign, on par with the Immortal Execution King.
“What a divine ancient Qin! It emits the qi of a peerless Sovereign Weapon. It will surely be good if I could acquire it.”
“Stop dreaming. Even if you acquired this ancient Qin, you won’t be able to wield it.”
Everyone was shocked. The emergence of the peerless Sovereign Weapon had attracted everyone’s attention. Everybody began to talk about the legends and history of Emperor Xiao Yao Qin.

“Big Yellow, look at the flames on top of the Qin. It seems comparable to my three supreme flames.” Jiang Chen’s eyes became as bright as a torch as they fell on the flames covering the surface of the Qin.
“That’s the flame of the Divine Bird Golden Crow. It’s the Fire of Sun.” Big Yellow replied carefully.
Xiao Yao - it means free and unfettered
Qin - A plucked seven-string Chinese musical instrument of the zither family.
